8ebd011d93ae0a189d8a.title: Sr. QA Analyst
8ebd011d93ae0a189d8a.description:
**Job Description**

**Timmons Group** is currently hiring a **Senior Quality Assurance Analyst** to join our Geospatial Solutions Development team, working remotely. This position will be supporting west coast clients and will be expected to work PST work hours. This position owns the testing process for a multi-year state government modernization program, delivered in sprints and releases under formal contract governance, independent verification and validation (IV&V), and change control. The position may also lead and support quality efforts for our other state, local, federal, and non-government clients.

This position is accountable to prove that what we deliver works, traces to approved requirements, and is ready for client testers to run on their own. The role sets the test strategy, leads QA, holds the quality gates for each story and release, and covers both functional and non-functional testing. It calls for close attention to detail and the judgment to tell a defect from a change in scope. We welcome candidates from consulting firms and from state or local government who have led testing on governed technology programs.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Own the end-to-end testing process, from test strategy and planning through release acceptance
* Maintain the test plan as a living document, including test levels and types, environments, entry and exit criteria, roles, and reporting
* Lead and review the work of QA analysts, assigning testing by story, capacity, and skill
* Ensure every acceptance criterion has a clear test case that any tester can run without help
* Direct functional, integration, database validation, smoke, regression, end-to-end, and UAT support testing
* Plan and coordinate non-functional testing, including performance, load, security, recovery, and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
* Maintain requirements traceability from requirement to story, test case, result, and defect
* Own the defect lifecycle and lead triage with client stakeholders, applying severity, priority, and release gates consistently
* Identify findings that are scope changes rather than defects and route them through change control with an impact analysis
* Produce test evidence and reports that support contract deliverables, IV&V reviews, and release acceptance
* Prepare client testers for each testing window and support their move from paired to independent testing
* Work with developers to expand automated testing in the CI pipeline and keep clear what is automated and what is manual
* Review AI-drafted test cases for coverage and intent before they are used
* Report test progress, defect trends, and release readiness to the project team and client

**Skills/Requirements of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 7+ years in software quality assurance, including 3+ years leading testing and owning the test process from plan through release is required
* Experience testing under formal governance, including written test plans, requirements traceability, contract deliverables, and change control; state government or IV&V experience is a plus
* Hands-on functional testing experience across integration, regression, end-to-end, database validation, and UAT
* Experience planning and interpreting non-functional testing, including performance, security scanning, and accessibility
* Strong defect management and triage skills, including working directly with client testers and stakeholders
* Exceptional attention to detail, with test cases and evidence that hold up to client and auditor review
* Experience with test automation (for example Playwright or Selenium) in a CI pipeline; experience testing geospatial applications and/or experience using ArcGIS Pro is a plus
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences; ISTQB or similar certifications are desirable
* Ability to work Pacific Time business hours for client testing windows and triage; comfort using AI tools in day-to-day work
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps Test Plans, Microsoft 365, and Smartsheet, or comparable tools

**Compensation:** Our best estimate of the salary range for this position is $80,000-$120,000. There may be flexibility on salary for experienced candidates. Offers are based on a range of job-related factors such as internal equity, experience, skills, education, credentials, role complexity, and location. Information on our comprehensive benefits package can be found here

 **Additional Information**

The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are looking for high energy, creative, flexible, patient, self-starters who are willing to work at a dynamic pace. Candidates must share a commitment to our company’s Vision, Mission and Shared Values.

**Timmons Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.**

**Timmons Group** is a multi-disciplined firm recognized nationally as a “Best Firm to Work For”. We help government and private clients alike to scale and grow through GIS services. With over 30 years providing expert GIS services, our award-winning team is ready to provide the flexible services to meet the needs of any organization. Our service expertise ranges from traditional GIS architecture and system configuration to custom application development to Enterprise Asset Management. We pride ourselves in being technology professionals that differentiate our services with unrivaled customer service. We are dedicated to solving challenges and helping our clients achieve their vision. For more information, visit www.timmonsgis.com.

61fa400711a846714e22.title: QA Coordinator
61fa400711a846714e22.description:
The Quality Assurance (QA) Coordinator serves as both a shift supervisor and quality inspector, ensuring that production lines operate efficiently, sanitation standards are upheld, and all products meet established quality and safety requirements. This role plays a key part in verifying thermal process parameters, supporting regulatory compliance, and maintaining the integrity of all quality assurance programs.

* Oversees and coordinates daily departmental quality assurance activities.
* Reviews and evaluates the quality of all products produced during the shift.
* Ensures any questionable product is placed on QA hold, properly red‑tagged, segregated, and accurately documented for management review.
* Verifies all process parameters on the production floor and at all cooker systems.
* Conducts verification of thermal processes during deviations, determines alternate processes when necessary, and ensures proper segregation and documentation to maintain product safety and regulatory compliance.
* Monitors line operations, documents all non‑conformances, and ensures production is halted when required until issues are fully resolved.
* Trains new employees on QA procedures, standards, and expectations.
* Evaluates incoming fresh‑pack product and recommends appropriate disposition prior to processing.
* Reviews production and quality records as applicable.
* Performs special projects, trials, and experiments assigned.
* Observes and reports the effectiveness of sanitation and cleanup in processing and warehouse areas, promptly escalating any serious deficiencies.
* Maintains cleanliness, organization, and proper functioning of all QA lab facilities, equipment, and incubators.
* Routinely reviews finished product analysis results to assess quality and material usage efficiency (yields).
* Understands where quality standards and product specifications are located and applies them appropriately; recommends revisions when needed.
* Continuously monitors for quality issues related to product or packaging, documenting and reporting concerns to Production and QA management.
* Ensures required samples are collected for Cutting Bees, customer programs, and co‑pack requirements.
* Develops familiarity with customer and USDA grading standards.
* Maintains working knowledge of all QA department roles.
* Identifies quality issues and takes or recommends effective corrective actions.
* Supports the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Manager as required.
* Executes all food safety, legality, and quality policies and procedures within the scope of the role, including but not limited to GMPs, HACCP, food safety, product quality, and food security.
* Performs additional related duties as assigned by QA leadership.
* Backs-up Quality Assurance Manager with assisting with Regulatory and BRCGS audits.

* High school diploma required. Associate’s degree in Food Science or a related field, or equivalent experience, preferred.
* Minimum 2 years of experience as a QA Inspector A.
* Successful completion of Better Process Control School.
* Strong math skills.
* Proficient computer skills – preferably in Microsoft Office programs.
* Demonstrated sound decision‑making skills and the ability to resolve problems quickly and effectively.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* HACCP and PCQI certificates preferred.

add4a216fa7b3ff3ae83.title: Founder Brand & Thought Leadership Lead (US)
add4a216fa7b3ff3ae83.description:
**Founder Brand & Thought Leadership Lead (US)**

**Location:** Remote, US-based (San Francisco, CA preferred)

**Type:** Full-time or long-term contractor

**Reports to:** Marc Tuscher, Co-Founder & CTO

**About us and the role**
-------------------------

Sereact builds AI software that lets robots see, understand and handle objects in real-world warehouses. We are growing fast in the US, and we want our co-founder Marc Tuscher to become one of the most recognized voices in physical AI and warehouse automation there.

You will own that mission end to end. You will run his presence on LinkedIn and X, get him into the right podcasts, publications and stages, and turn every appearance into content. Think of yourself as his chief of staff for public voice, not a social media scheduler. This is not a classic marketing role: you won't run ads, campaigns or lead generation. Your job is to build trust and authority around one person, mostly through earned media that can't be bought.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the narrative.** Define 2–3 core themes and a clear point of view for Marc, together with him and our leadership team.
* **Run LinkedIn and X.** Draft, edit and publish posts in his voice, several times a week. Engage with comments, build relationships with relevant voices and grow a following among US operations, supply chain and robotics leaders.
* **Tell Sereact's stories every day.** Collect daily wins, milestones and behind-the-scenes stories from all Sereact locations and customer sites (new deployments, robots going live, customer results, the people behind them) and tell them through Marc's eyes: what he learned, what surprised him, why it matters for the industry. Work with our teams and customers on approvals, photos and video, within customer confidentiality.
* **Book podcasts.** Identify the right shows in AI, robotics, logistics, manufacturing and startups, pitch hosts and prepare him for each recording.
* **Land bylines and press.** Find target publications (trade and business media), pitch op-eds and interviews, and work with journalists and, if needed, a PR agency.
* **Secure stages.** Get him speaking slots at US conferences, trade shows and industry dinners, and submit award and list nominations.
* **Repurpose everything.** Turn each podcast, talk or article into clips, posts and newsletter content.
* **Measure what matters.** Track reach within our target audience, inbound leads, media mentions and booked appearances, and report monthly.

**How you work with our marketing team**
----------------------------------------

Our marketing team owns the Sereact brand, website, campaigns, trade show booths and lead generation. You own Marc's personal voice and his earned media: his LinkedIn and X accounts, podcasts, bylines, interviews and talks.

Stories, approvals and big moments are planned together in the middle; each side then tells them in its own voice and is measured on its own results.

* You share customer stories and milestones with marketing, so one story can live on Marc's account and on Sereact's channels without duplicate work.
* You align with marketing on key moments such as product launches, funding news and major trade shows, and plan his appearances around them.
* Customer approvals run through one shared process, so customers are asked once, not twice.
* Your success is measured differently: not by leads or ad performance, but by appearances, media mentions, reach among US decision-makers and the inbound conversations he gets as a result.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 5+ years in executive communications, founder branding, PR or journalism, ideally in tech or deep tech. A background mainly in performance or campaign marketing is not what we're looking for.
* A track record of building a founder's or executive's presence on LinkedIn and/or X, with examples and numbers you can show us.
* An existing network of podcast hosts, journalists, editors or event organizers in the US.
* Excellent writing in American English: you can capture someone else's voice and make technical topics sharp and human.
* Strong judgment on what to say and what not to say publicly.
* Self-starter mindset: you work independently across time zones with a team based in Germany.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in robotics, AI, logistics, supply chain or manufacturing.
* Short-form video skills (editing clips for LinkedIn, X and YouTube).
* Experience with newsletters (Substack, beehiiv) or running a podcast.
* Knowledge of US industry events such as ProMat, MODEX, Automate or CES.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Direct, daily work with a founder at a fast-growing AI and robotics company.
* Real ownership: you shape the strategy, not just execute it.
* Budget for tools, travel to US events and occasional trips to our team in Germany.
* Flexible, remote-first setup.
* Competitive salary and benefits

**How to apply**
----------------

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and 2–3 examples of executives or founders whose presence you built, with the results. Tell us in a few sentences how you would position Marc in his first 90 days.

9601378c3d6e1b89f14d.title: Business Development Representative
9601378c3d6e1b89f14d.description:
**Business Development Representative**
=======================================

* Full time
* Location: Remote, with regular travel to meet prospects and attend trade shows and industry events
* Base salary: $65,00; OTE: $108k (based on potential commission earnings)

This isn't a dial-and-log-it BDR role. We sell to large contractors, and the people you'll talk to are CFOs, controllers and operations leaders who expect you to understand their business. You'll work a short list of high-value accounts, research deeply, run the first qualifying conversation yourself, and hand our AEs opportunities that are qualified, multi-threaded and ready to close.

**About Assignar**

Assignar is a mission-led construction tech company. Sean McCreanor (co-founder and CEO) started Assignar in 2014 after running his own contracting business and finding there weren't any good tools for it. Today we work with hundreds of customers, from multi-million-dollar contractors to specialist crews.

We've found product-market fit. Assignar is the all-in-one margin control platform for contractors. leading digital construction operations for contractors: real-time visibility across jobsites, smart scheduling of workers to projects, equipment tracking, and data that shapes the next bid. We connect the field and finance so contractors protect margin on every job and get paid accurately and faster.

**What does "own the top of the funnel" actually mean?**

You'll sit inside the Marketing team and be the first real conversation most contractors have with Assignar. You'll decide who's worth pursuing, find the right people inside them, run the first discovery conversation, keep it warm and set up the AE to win.

You'll report to Madeline Crowley (VP of Marketing) and work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers and Marketing. What you hear from prospects every day will shape how we go to market.

**What you'll own**

* **Go after the right accounts.** Research and prioritise target accounts with your AE and Marketing, and qualify inbound leads hard against our ICP. Move on quickly from accounts that don't fit. Spend your time where it counts.
* **Start conversations that go somewhere.** Run multi-channel outreach (phone, email, LinkedIn and video) personalised to each recipient. Multi-thread every account to reach finance and operations leaders, not just one contact.
* **Keep warm prospects warm.** Nurture prospects between meetings with follow-up that's useful, not pushy.
* **Turn engagement into pipeline.** Follow up personally with prospects who attend our webinars, events and campaigns.
* **Set the AE up to win.** Hand off opportunities with the buying group mapped, the economic buyer identified, the problem sized and a dated next step.
* **Show up in person.** Attend trade shows and industry events like CCF and association days, and meet contractors where they are.
* **Run discovery yourself.** Lead video qualification calls with an industry-specific deck. Confirm fit, identify the economic buyer and size the problem before the opportunity moves to an AE.
* **Close the loop with feedback.** Share what's landing and what isn't.
* **Keep Salesforce clean.** Using agents, log every call, email and meeting, and keep lead and contact records current so anyone on the team can pick up an account and know exactly where it's at.
* **Own your number.** You're measured on qualified pipeline and revenue from right-fit accounts, not meetings booked.

**Who you are**

* **An experienced BDR.** 2+ years in B2B sales development, ideally selling into mid-market or enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders. SaaS preferred, and construction or trades experience is a bonus.
* **Pipeline-driven.** You have a track record of hitting or beating your number on qualified pipeline or revenue, not just activity.
* **At home in the modern sales stack.** Salesforce, Salesloft and Clay feel familiar, and you use AI tools to research and personalise faster.
* **A sharp writer and communicator.** The best BDRs at Assignar write emails that customers actually reply to, because they're written for the recipient, not the sender. They're just as strong on the phone and on video.
* **Curious about construction.** You don't need to have worked in the industry, but you want to understand how contractors run their business.
* **Organised and self-directed.** You manage your own pipeline, move fast and like being part of a supportive team.
* **Resourceful.** You don't wait for leads. You build your own target lists from industry associations, customer lookalikes and public project data.
* **Comfortable talking to finance.** You can hold a credible conversation with a CFO or controller about margin, cash flow and job costing.
* **Ambitious.** You want to grow into an AE role, and you'll keep building your skills, especially with AI, to get there.

**The tools you'll work with**

Salesforce · Salesloft · Clay · AI tools and agents · Apollo · JustCall

**Why Join**

* You'll be part of a company with real product-market fit and a clear market to go after.
* You'll work directly with go-to-market team members and participate in turning your daily work into revenue.
* You'll get out to events and meet the people who use our product.
* You'll be in a small team where your ideas about what's working get heard and used.

**How we hire**

We keep it quick and practical. We care about how you think, how you write and how you talk to people.

* **Apply via Breezy.** Tell us a bit about yourself and what you've been working on.
* **Phone screen with Sophie, Head of People & Culture (30 min).** Get to know each other and ask us anything.
* **Interview with Madeline, VP of Marketing (45 to 60 min).** Your experience, how you prospect and how you work with a sales team.
* **Reference checks.** We'll speak with two or three people you've worked with, ideally a former manager, to hear how you prospect, how you handle a number and what you're like on a team.

**What we stand for: Our Values**

* Do what's right
* Customers are our why
* Grow with purpose
* One team

We value inclusion and welcome applicants from every background. If any part of this process needs to look different for you, let us know and we'll adjust.

No recruiters please · We respond to every application within 5 business days

04d8dc229ad748d5fadd.title: Marketing Specialist
04d8dc229ad748d5fadd.description:
**Keystone Med Waste Solutions**

Reports to: Head of Sales and Marketing

Location: Fully remote

Employment: Full-time

Travel: Minimal, as needed for select events or meetings

**Compensation & Benefits**

Base Salary: $75,000 to 90,000 annually, commensurate with experience

**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Paid holidays
* 401(k)
* Professional development opportunities

**About Keystone**

Keystone Med Waste Solutions is a growing medical waste management company providing collection, transportation, treatment, and compliance support to healthcare organizations across multiple US states and regions.

Keystone serves a diverse range of healthcare organizations, from independent practices and community health centers to multi-location healthcare systems and specialty providers.

**Our commitment is simple: Elite Service. Expert Compliance. Competitive Value.**

We believe medical waste management should be one less thing our customers have to worry about. Through dependable service, responsive support, customized solutions, and a commitment to compliance, we're building lasting partnerships with the healthcare organizations we serve.

As we expand our geographic reach, service capabilities, and treatment infrastructure, we're looking for a talented, hands-on Marketing Specialist to help strengthen our brand, accelerate growth, and generate measurable business results.

**The Role**

The Marketing Specialist will lead the execution of Keystone's marketing initiatives, translating business priorities into effective campaigns that build awareness, generate qualified leads, support sales, and contribute to revenue growth.

Reporting to the Head of Sales and Marketing, this individual will manage day-to-day marketing activities across digital channels, email, content development, direct mail, trade shows, and sales support.

This is a hands-on, results-oriented position for someone who enjoys both the creative and analytical sides of marketing. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, an organized project manager, and a resourceful marketer who can move comfortably between strategy and execution.

You'll work closely with sales, customer success, operations, and leadership to ensure marketing efforts support Keystone's growth priorities, target the right healthcare organizations, and communicate our value effectively.

You'll also coordinate established freelance partners, manage approved budgets, and help build scalable marketing processes as the company grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

Brand Management and Content Development

* Maintain and strengthen Keystone's brand identity, messaging, and visual consistency across all marketing channels.
* Develop compelling, professional content for websites, email campaigns, brochures, presentations, sales materials, case studies, and other communications.
* Clearly communicate Keystone's competitive differentiators, including service reliability, compliance expertise, customer support, flexibility, and overall value.
* Develop educational content that helps healthcare organizations better understand medical waste management, regulatory considerations, employee safety, and operational best practices.
* Maintain and organize current marketing assets, templates, and brand resources.
* Coordinate freelance designers, writers, and other creative partners, providing direction, reviewing deliverables, and managing deadlines.
* Ensure technical, operational, and compliance-related content is accurate and appropriately reviewed before publication.

Digital Marketing and Lead Generation

* Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns designed to generate qualified leads and measurable sales opportunities.
* Manage paid search, organic search, email marketing, social media, website content, and landing page initiatives.
* Maintain and improve Keystone's website, including content updates, SEO, conversion optimization, and lead-generation functionality.
* Develop targeted campaigns for specific healthcare segments, geographic markets, and service offerings.
* Monitor campaign performance, advertising spend, lead quality, conversion rates, and return on investment.
* Identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness through testing, analytics, and ongoing optimization.
* Coordinate digital campaigns with sales outreach and prospect follow-up.

HubSpot, Marketing Automation, and CRM

* Manage marketing activities within HubSpot, including contact segmentation, email campaigns, forms, lists, workflows, and lead-nurturing programs.
* Develop and maintain automated campaigns that support prospect engagement throughout the sales cycle.
* Partner with sales to maintain accurate prospect data, campaign attribution, lead-source tracking, and effective lead handoffs.
* Develop targeted audience lists based on healthcare segment, geography, service needs, and other relevant criteria.
* Maintain reliable tracking and reporting through HubSpot, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and related tools.
* Build dashboards and reports that provide visibility into marketing performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and revenue results.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, automation, and CRM data quality.

Sales Enablement and Business Development Support

* Work closely with the sales team to develop targeted prospecting campaigns, outreach materials, and lead-generation initiatives.
* Create and maintain sales presentations, brochures, capability statements, proposal templates, and other business development resources.
* Support the development of marketing content for RFP responses, major proposals, and strategic business opportunities.
* Coordinate marketing campaigns with sales outreach to improve prospect engagement and conversion.
* Gather customer insights, competitive intelligence, and sales feedback to refine messaging and campaign strategies.
* Help develop marketing initiatives that support customer referrals, strategic partnerships, and new business opportunities.

Market Expansion and Targeted Campaigns

* Develop marketing campaigns supporting Keystone's geographic expansion, transportation coverage, treatment capabilities, and new market opportunities.
* Work with leadership and operations to align marketing activity with service availability, operational capacity, and strategic growth priorities.
* Develop differentiated messaging and campaigns for various healthcare segments, including independent practices, specialty providers, and multi-location organizations.
* Support marketing initiatives surrounding new services, treatment facilities, partnerships, and other company developments.
* Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and market penetration in priority regions.

Customer Marketing and Engagement

* Develop and manage customer-facing communications, including newsletters, educational resources, service updates, and other engagement initiatives.
* Partner with Customer Success to identify opportunities for customer education, testimonials, referrals, and relationship development.
* Help communicate Keystone's service capabilities, compliance resources, and additional solutions to existing customers.
* Support customer retention and account growth through relevant, informative, and consistent communications.

Trade Shows, Events and Direct Mail

* Manage planning and execution for designated trade shows, conferences, and industry events, including budgets, registration, booth materials, promotional items, shipping, and vendor coordination.
* Develop pre-event promotional campaigns, attendee outreach, lead-capture processes, and post-event follow-up strategies.
* Coordinate event participation with sales and leadership, ensuring clear objectives and appropriate materials.
* Develop targeted direct mail campaigns based on geography, healthcare segment, and service opportunities.
* Manage mailing lists, creative development, printing, vendors, schedules, and campaign tracking.
* Measure event and direct mail effectiveness through qualified leads, opportunities, and resulting revenue.
* Most event coordination will be handled remotely.

Marketing Planning, Budgeting and Performance

* Maintain an integrated marketing calendar with clearly defined priorities, deliverables, deadlines, and campaign objectives.
* Manage approved marketing budgets and outside vendor expenses.
* Establish measurable campaign goals and regularly report results to the Head of Sales and Marketing.
* Evaluate marketing effectiveness based on qualified lead generation, pipeline contribution, customer acquisition, and return on investment.
* Recommend improvements to marketing strategies, processes, and resource allocation based on performance data.
* Collaborate across departments to ensure marketing priorities remain aligned with company objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* At least 3–5 years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including direct responsibility for campaign execution and performance.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads and support revenue growth.
* Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex services into clear, compelling messages.
* Hands-on experience with email marketing, digital advertising, website management, SEO, and marketing analytics.
* Practical experience with CRM systems, marketing automation, audience segmentation, and lead-nurturing campaigns.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, freelance partners, and outside vendors.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and meet deadlines.
* Comfortable analyzing marketing performance, identifying opportunities, and making data-driven recommendations.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and collaborate effectively in a fully remote environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and quality control, with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, competing priorities, and tight deadlines without compromising the quality of work.
* Experience in healthcare, medical waste, environmental services, logistics, or another regulated B2B service industry.
* Strong working knowledge of HubSpot, including email campaigns, workflows, segmentation, reporting, and CRM integration.
* Experience with Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and WordPress/Elementor.
* Experience marketing to healthcare administrators, operations leaders, procurement professionals, and other organizational decision-makers.
* Experience supporting sales teams through targeted prospecting campaigns, presentations, proposals, and marketing collateral.
* Experience with geographic market expansion or multi-location service businesses.
* Experience developing and coordinating trade shows, conferences, direct mail, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Ability to create and edit marketing materials using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful Marketing Specialist will help Keystone build a more consistent, effective, and measurable marketing program.

Success will be demonstrated through:

* Brand consistency: Keystone presents a clear, professional, and differentiated brand across all channels and materials.
* Qualified lead generation: Marketing consistently produces relevant opportunities in priority healthcare segments and serviceable geographic markets.
* Sales alignment: Marketing and sales work together through coordinated campaigns, effective lead handoffs, and shared performance goals.
* Campaign execution: Marketing initiatives are well organized, delivered on schedule, and managed within approved budgets.
* Marketing effectiveness: Campaign performance is regularly evaluated and optimized based on lead quality, conversion, pipeline contribution, and revenue.
* Customer engagement: Existing customers receive valuable, consistent communications that strengthen relationships and support retention.
* Operational independence: Marketing activities move forward efficiently, with strong ownership, sound judgment, and minimal day-to-day oversight.
* Scalable processes: Keystone develops repeatable marketing systems, tools, and resources that support continued growth.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We're looking for someone who combines creativity, initiative, exceptional attention to detail, and a strong sense of accountability.

Someone who can write a compelling email in the morning, optimize a campaign in HubSpot, coordinate a new sales brochure, and analyze lead-generation performance — all while keeping the bigger business objectives in mind.

Exceptional attention to detail is essential. This role involves managing multiple projects, campaigns, deadlines, and moving parts simultaneously. The successful candidate must be highly organized, meticulous in their work, and committed to accuracy and quality. From customer-facing communications and campaign execution to CRM data, reporting, and brand consistency, we expect someone who takes ownership of the details, catches potential errors before they become problems, and consistently delivers polished, professional work.

You'll be comfortable working in a growing organization where priorities evolve, initiative is valued, and the ability to manage competing demands without sacrificing quality is critical.

Most importantly, you'll understand that great marketing isn't simply about creating content or generating activity. It's about communicating value, building trust, supporting sales, and helping grow the business.

e321c68030f8f09446ed.title: Manager, Payroll Tax Operations
e321c68030f8f09446ed.description:
**Overview**
------------

Come join Payroll Tax Operations (PTO) as a people manager leading a high-performing team of payroll tax experts. In this role you will lead a cross-functional team of Tax Processors responsible for the end-to-end resolution of payroll tax issues across all four core processes: Notices, Corrections, Amendments, and Pay & File. We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced people manager with deep hands-on payroll tax expertise, a passion for developing people, and the operational discipline to hold a high bar for performance, quality, and customer outcomes across a high-volume case environment.

This role requires an experienced practitioner who has personally resolved complex State and Federal payroll tax notices, amended tax returns across multiple states, and corrected payroll tax errors at the source and who can now coach and lead a team to do the same. The ideal candidate is a payroll tax specialist, not a generalist.

**Responsibilities**

* Translate the vision and values of PTO into a compelling team strategy that drives day-to-day priorities and a 1+ year operating plan aligned to department goals.
* Own delivery and quality outcomes for your assigned team, ensuring SLA compliance across all active cases and eliminating backlogs to reduce customer burden.
* Lead a team of Tax Processors through regular Monthly Check-Ins, structured SBIC feedback, performance coaching, and career development conversations.
* Serve as the final internal escalation point for the most complex IRS and state agency notices, penalty assessments, cross-jurisdictional discrepancies, and multi-quarter audit inquiries arriving with a resolution strategy, not just a problem.
* Drive utilization of lean management practices including Daily Huddles, WIP reviews, and performance board management to surface and solve problems in real time.
* Partner with team to monitor team WIP daily; identify aging cases, holds, and systemic blockers; enforce intake and closure workflows to ensure no notice, payroll correction, and amended return exceeds agency deadlines without documented action.
* Own SOP and Knowledge Base (KB) governance; direct team in authoring and validating process documentation; translate IRS and state regulatory updates into team briefings and SOP revisions with effective dates.
* Drive hiring, onboarding, and skills calibration for new team members; proactively build succession depth at the team level.
* Continuously assess and improve processes within team scope; identify upstream and downstream dependencies; recommend and implement improvements that eliminate non-value-added work.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams that deliver high-quality customer experiences in a high-volume, high-stakes service environment

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of people management experience in a payroll tax operations or related service environment, with a demonstrated track record of developing others' skills and careers.
* 5+ years of hands-on payroll tax experience with a strong focus on notice resolution, amended return preparation, and payroll error correction across multiple states, beyond general payroll administration.
* Proven experience resolving complex IRS and state agency correspondence including, penalty assessments, and state balance-due and delinquency notices.
* Demonstrated experience preparing and approving amended Federal (Form 941-X, W-2c) and State payroll tax returns across 10 or more states, including jurisdictions with complex local requirements such as PA, OH, and more.
* Deep knowledge of federal payroll tax law: FICA, FUTA, FITW, employment tax deposit schedules, and associated penalty and interest structures.
* Multi-state payroll tax expertise: reciprocal agreements, resident and nonresident taxation, SUI account management, and local tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
* Strong analytical skills; able to identify trends in case data, conduct root-cause analysis, and translate findings into corrective actions and process improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to simplify complex payroll tax issues for processors at all levels and for cross-functional partners.
* Proficiency with at least one enterprise payroll platform and experience with case management systems such as Salesforce. Prior experience at a payroll service bureau, PEO, or multi-client tax operations centers strongly preferred.
* BS/BA in Accounting, Finance, or Business preferred; equivalent experience accepted.
* Possess an active Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) preferred; required within 12 months of hire. Enrolled Agent (EA) designation is a strong differentiator. FPC accepted candidates actively pursuing CPP.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). 1009655749a6e47670f3.title: GROC Manager of Life Safety & Security Operations
1009655749a6e47670f3.description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**GROC Manager of Life Safety / Security Operations**

**Position Summary**

The GROC Life Safety / Security Manager reports to JLL GROC Leadership is responsible for strategic leadership, operational oversight, and continuous improvement of the Life Safety/Security Communications Division within the Global Response & Operations Center. This role ensures the delivery of 24/7 mission-critical communication, dispatch, and emergency response services supporting security, EH&S, law enforcement, fire, EMS, travel risk, and global crisis management.

The Manager leads a multi-layered team and drives program maturity, global consistency, and innovation, while ensuring strong alignment with enterprise risk, safety, and operational priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership & Oversight**

Provide leadership to Supervisors, Team Leads, and Communication Specialists, ensuring alignment with GROC and enterprise objectives.

* Foster a high-performance, inclusive team culture that promotes accountability, collaboration, and engagement
* Ensure timely escalation of personnel issues to JLL GROC Leadership
* Initiate thorough and complete internal investigations, reviewing outcomes with JLL GROC Leadership and HR when necessary. This includes identification of policy/procedure violations, incident root cause analysis when appropriate, and collaboration with Client and JLL Leadership. Document the findings and make recommendations on further action to JLL GROC Leadership.

* Identify and track program/process gaps and near misses, driving corrective actions.
* Lead workforce planning, including staffing models, scheduling strategy, and succession planning.
* Maintain strong engagement across all shifts, including regular floor presence, pop-in checks, and touchpoints.
* Conduct regular team lead meetings to communicate updates, share lessons learned, and address operational challenges.

**Incident Management**

* Oversee 24/7 global communications center operations, ensuring high-quality, consistent dispatch and communications services.
* Coordinate the GROC’s initial and ongoing response to major incidents, including multi-day events.
* Ensure timely updates to key stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of incidents.
* Ensure effective coordination with security, EH&S, police, fire, EMS, and crisis management teams.
* Serve as senior escalation authority for complex and high-risk incidents.
* Oversee real-time monitoring of global security events, including:
  + Physical security threats
  + Travel safety risks
  + Geopolitical developments
  + Environmental hazards
* Conduct post-incident reviews and lessons-learned debriefs to improve future response.
* Oversee use of Critical Event Management platforms (Everbridge) to communicate emergencies and account for personnel globally.
* Ensure accurate monitoring, dispatch, and impairment management of fire/life safety systems across global sites.
* Coordinate with third-party monitoring providers and emergency responders.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead training strategy and execution, including:
  + Tabletop exercises and pop-up drills
  + Scenario-based incident simulations
* Ensure follow-up on development plans based on exercise findings.
* Close process and program gaps identified during exercises.
* Coordinate mandatory training, certification tracking, and expiration management.
* Develop structured training tracks and career growth pathways.
* Build external benchmarking networks with other SOCs/GSOCs to drive innovation and best practices.

**Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities**

* Oversee payroll processes, including weekly timesheet review to ensure accurate documentation of time and submit approvals.
* Manage team scheduling to ensure proper staffing levels are achieved while minimizing overtime impact.

* Provide executive oversight of all communication channels (calls, emails, alerts, notifications).
* Conduct QA programs for call handling, dispatch accuracy, and response performance.
* Support escalated communications and complex dispatch scenarios as needed.

**Program Strategy & Technology**

* Partner with the Technical Support Manager to identify and implement system improvements to enhance GROC capabilities.
* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies (including AI) to improve efficiency, automation, and situational awareness.
* Oversee team usage of systems including:
  + CAD (D3 Security)
  + Access Control (C\*Cure)
  + Everbridge (Mass Notification)
  + Radio/Intercom systems

* Ensure systems are fully operational, integrated, and optimized.
* Engage with BMS and JLL EHS and operational teams to build relationships and be part of site level teams to improve GROC reliability and service delivery
* Participate in enterprise initiatives to align global safety and security strategies.

* Ensure GROC business continuity plans (BCP) are reviewed and updated at least quarterly.
* Validate operational readiness for continuity and disaster recovery scenarios.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory, operational, and industry standards.

**Reporting & Performance Management**

* Oversee reporting on:
  + Call volume and response times
  + Incident metrics and trends
  + Customer satisfaction
* Provide insight and recommendations to leadership.
* Drive data-informed decisions to improve performance, service delivery, and risk mitigation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associate’s degree (Bachelor’s preferred) or equivalent experience.
* Experience in security communications, life safety, or emergency dispatch operations.
* Experience managing multi-layered teams in a 24/7 environment.
* Strong experience in incident command, crisis response, and global operations.

**Certifications Preferred:**

* Public Safety Telecommunicator I
* Emergency Medical Dispatcher (EMD)
* CPR

**Desired Technical Skills**

* Everbridge (Mass Notification / Command Center)
* Travel risk tools (Travel Tracker, Vismo)
* C\*Cure Monitoring/Admin
* D3 Security CAD
* Zetron, Eventide, Commend systems
* Microsoft Office Suite

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic leadership & operational excellence
* Crisis and incident management
* Investigations & root cause analysis
* Talent development & team engagement
* Data-driven decision making
* Technology innovation & systems integration
* Cross-functional influence
* Communication & Stakeholder Management
* Attention to Detail & Situational Awareness

**Additional Information**

* This role requires flexibility to support a 24/7 operation, including off-hours escalation support, and regular face time with all shifts, including pop-in checks
* The Manager will play a key role in driving continuous improvement, training excellence, and system reliability

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

**Expected compensation for this position:**

  
84,000.00 – 94,000.00 USD per year

*Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.*

On-site –Lawrence, NJ

0cdaee3e6321ce9c6310.title: Fiscal Coordinator
0cdaee3e6321ce9c6310.description:
**Summary**
-----------

The Fiscal Coordinator will perform a variety of financial and accounting technical tasks in support of the daily financial operations for the Department of Emergency Services through the provision of high-quality financial reports and analysis. Works with the Fiscal Supervisor to standardize the policies, procedures and analysis reporting within the Administrative Division and the Department of Emergency Services. Supports the mission of the Department of Emergency Services by promoting and assisting in providing safety and security to Chester County citizens so they can work, live and grow in a healthy and safe community.
  
  
**All Department of Emergency Services employees are essential personnel and may be required to work during non-business hours for extended periods of time. Essential employee duties may involve assignments within the Emergency Operations Center (EOC), deployment to a field location, or other duties as required during periods of emergencies or training/exercise. Emergency assignments may be performed under adverse conditions, continue for periods ranging from a few hours to several weeks, and may require travel.**

**Essential Duties**
--------------------

* Prepares purchase orders, vouchers, receivables, revenue, expenditures and accounts payable.
* Maintains vendor contracts with coordination through Procurement and General Services for compliance.
* Prepares and inputs journal entries for budget, accounts payable, cash receipts, expenditure, and revenue adjustments.

* Prepares inter-fund transfers, as needed.
* Distributes checks to vendors.
* Prepares deposits as needed, including proper account coding.
* Works with the Treasurer’s Office to reconcile transactions against monthly bank statement.
* Analyzes expenditure, revenue and balance sheet accounts for accuracy and makes appropriate adjustments.
* Tracks invoices and payments for contracted supplies & services.
* Assists with preparing employee reimbursement for travel, mileage, and related expenses.
* Maintains Employee Training/Travel Tracking system, as needed.
* Coordinates resources for independent audits to ensure compliance with program regulations.
* Performs analyses and reconciliation of financial data, as required.
* Prepares monthly detailed revenue and expenditure report.
* Prepares and maintains contract database for continuity of services and historical data.
* Maintains the department’s manual and electronic accounting records.

* Maintains the General Ledger, special funds, and grants.
* Prepares Financial Reports; as needed.
* Tower rental cost.
* Revenue.
* Grants Billing and Payments.
* Financial reports to PEMA on an as needed basis.
* Interacts with vendors and county personnel, as needed.
* Assists the Fiscal Supervisor with budget process.
* Communicates with county departments to resolve any issues pertaining to submitted vouchers.
* Assists with managingthe department’s Vehicle Fleet.
* Keeps inventory of any outdated equipment within each division and removes it in accordance with Procurement/Controller guidelines.
* Collaborates with the Controllers on Tower Site Expenditures and Revenue in accordance with each contract, including annual increases and amendments.
* Serves as a liaison with all funding sources and independent auditors to ensure compliance with funding source rules and regulations, compliance with applicable laws, and to maintain appropriate program cash flow.
* Coordinates workflow from others in the department and consolidates the data given by accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll to facilitate month-end and year-end closings.
* Assists with Emergency Operations Center (EOC) activations and drills.

Performs other duties, tasks, and projects as necessary or assigned.

**Qualifications/Preferred Skills, Knowledge & Experience**
-----------------------------------------------------------

**Required:**

* Associate’s degree from an accredited college or university, three years of job-related experience, or any equivalent combination of education and experience.
* General knowledge of the County Code (state law) and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
* Experience with automated accounting and recordkeeping systems.

**Preferred:**
  

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field.

Four or more years of job-related experience, with preference for nonprofit roles.
  
  
**Other Qualifications, Skills, Knowledge and abilities**
  
  
Strong demonstrated abilities required:
  

* Verbal and written skills
* Listening and Communication skills
* Interpersonal skills
* Customer Service skills
* Analytical/Problem Solving skills
* Organizational skills
* Time Management Skills
* Presentation skills
* Project Management skills
* Prioritization/Multi-tasking skills
* Motivated/Works Independently
* Detail Oriented/Accurate
* Sound Analysis/Judgement skills
* Confidentiality
* Honest, Integrity and Professionalism
* Strong work ethic and willingness to learn new tasks

  
Also required:
  

* Ability to analyze expenditure, revenue and balance sheet accounts for accuracy and make appropriate adjustments.
* Ability to audit accounts on a regular basis to ensure accuracy.
* Ability to generate financial statements.
* Ability to maintain the General Ledger, special funds, and grants.
* Strong working knowledge of budgets, spreadsheets and interpreting audits.
* Ability to make journal entries for payroll, accounts payable and cash receipts.
* Ability to prepare cash transfers for disbursement.
* Creating timely and accurate financial reporting is essential to this position.
* Ability to interface effectively with all levels of county management.

8306e8064db8d8ae02e7.description:
Regional Administrator – Behavioral Health Operations

**Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide**

**Location:** Philadelphia, PA and Surrounding Areas  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Monday–Friday  
**Salary:** Starting at $85,000 Annually + Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities  
**Schedule:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM | No Weekends or Holidays  
**Work Setting:** Field-Based / On-Site at Partner Facilities

About Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide

Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide is a growing behavioral health organization dedicated to providing high-quality psychiatric and therapeutic services to patients in skilled nursing facilities, nursing homes, and assisted living communities.

Originally founded by Dr. Pari Deshmukh, a triple board-certified psychiatrist, Balanced Wellbeing has grown and evolved through its partnership with a larger healthcare organization. While we continue to expand our reach and resources nationwide, we remain committed to maintaining the collaborative, supportive, and close-knit culture that has always defined our team.

Our mission is to improve access to compassionate, patient-centered behavioral healthcare while providing our clinical teams with the leadership, resources, and support they need to succeed.

Position Overview

Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide is seeking a motivated, organized, and experienced **Regional Administrator** to oversee and support behavioral health operations throughout **Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and surrounding communities**.

This position serves as a key operational leader responsible for supporting our Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs), therapists, and partner facilities. The Regional Administrator ensures providers have the tools, resources, schedules, and operational support necessary to deliver exceptional patient care while meeting organizational expectations.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced healthcare environment, builds strong professional relationships, and can independently manage multiple priorities.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring regular travel between assigned facilities and direct engagement with clinical providers, facility leadership, and corporate operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Regional Operations & Leadership**

* Oversee daily behavioral health operations across assigned skilled nursing and assisted living facilities.
* Provide direct operational supervision, guidance, and support to PMHNPs and therapists throughout the region.
* Ensure providers maintain appropriate schedules, patient volumes, and productivity expectations.
* Monitor provider performance, documentation compliance, and adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Identify operational challenges and implement effective solutions to improve efficiency and patient care.
* Collaborate with clinical leadership and corporate operations to support regional growth and organizational objectives.

**Provider Support & Coordination**

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for providers within the assigned region.
* Assist with provider scheduling, patient assignments, and facility coverage to ensure continuity of care.
* Review and approve employee timecards, PTO requests, and scheduling adjustments in accordance with company policies.
* Ensure providers have access to necessary equipment, technology, and rounding materials.
* Support onboarding, training, and integration of new clinical team members.
* Address provider concerns and facilitate communication between clinical staff and leadership.

**Facility Relationships & Communication**

* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with facility administrators, directors of nursing, and other healthcare professionals.
* Serve as a liaison between Balanced Wellbeing, clinical providers, and partner facilities.
* Address facility concerns promptly and professionally while maintaining a high standard of customer service.
* Coordinate with facility leadership to identify opportunities for improved service delivery and patient access.
* Represent Balanced Wellbeing at facility meetings, regional events, and other professional engagements as needed.

**Quality Assurance & Administrative Oversight**

* Monitor timely and accurate completion of clinical documentation and required operational reporting.
* Review productivity reports, provider schedules, and regional performance metrics.
* Ensure compliance with company protocols, facility requirements, and applicable healthcare regulations.
* Work collaboratively with credentialing, human resources, scheduling, and clinical leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
* Participate in regular leadership meetings and provide updates regarding regional performance, staffing, and operational needs.

Qualifications & Requirements

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous experience in healthcare operations, administration, team leadership, or a related field.
* Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing responsibilities, and make sound operational decisions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, electronic documentation systems, and other workplace technology.
* Ability to develop and maintain professional relationships with healthcare providers and facility leadership.
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel regularly throughout the assigned region.
* Ability to successfully complete all required background screenings and facility credentialing requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in behavioral health, psychiatry, skilled nursing, assisted living, or long-term care environments.
* Previous experience supervising clinical providers or managing healthcare operations across multiple locations.
* Familiarity with healthcare productivity metrics, provider scheduling, and clinical documentation requirements.
* Experience working with PMHNPs, nurse practitioners, therapists, or other healthcare professionals.
* Associate's or bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

**Compensation**

* Starting salary of **$85,000 annually**
* Performance-based bonus opportunities
* Full-time, salaried position

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching
* Company-paid and voluntary life insurance options
* Short-term disability and supplemental insurance options
* Paid time off (PTO), with accrual increasing based on years of service
* Six paid company holidays
* Professional development and advancement opportunities
* Supportive leadership and a collaborative team environment

Work Schedule & Location

* **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
* **Weekends:** Not regularly required
* **Holidays:** No regularly scheduled holiday work
* **Location:** Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and surrounding communities
* **Travel:** Regular local and regional travel between assigned partner facilities
* **Work Environment:** Primarily on-site within skilled nursing facilities, assisted living communities, and other assigned healthcare locations

Why Join Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide?

At Balanced Wellbeing, we recognize that exceptional patient care begins with exceptional people. Our Regional Administrators play an essential role in supporting our clinical teams, strengthening facility partnerships, and ensuring that our providers can focus on what matters most—delivering quality behavioral healthcare.

As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, take ownership of regional operations, and grow professionally within an expanding nationwide healthcare organization.

**If you are a motivated healthcare leader who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and supporting clinical teams, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide family.**

*Balanced Wellbeing Nationwide is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants.*

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $85,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

c86e07ad1c6fe4f69cfd.title: Senior Manager, Digital Clinical Operations
c86e07ad1c6fe4f69cfd.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

**General Description:**

The **Senior Manager, Digital Clinical Operations** is responsible to enhance Global Clinical Operations productivity and reduce clinical trial inefficiencies, by setting the strategy, as well as shaping, defining, and delivering business critical digital capabilities. This role will provide digital leadership across investigator fee management, study and site budgeting, site contracting, payment and invoice management, reconciliation, forecasting and variance analytics. The Senior Manager will lead cross-functional digital initiatives from opportunity identification and business case development through implementation, adoption, and value realization, partnering across GCO, technical and data teams, and external technology providers.

The technology ecosystem includes a combination of anchor applications, both homegrown and SaaS, exploratory innovations, as well as analytics capabilities.

This role will specifically focus on following activities:

* Define and detail enhancements for digital solutions used by the budgeting, site contracting, payment and data hub teams.
* Engage with clinical stakeholders across geographies and functions, to create a clear voice of the clinical teams for the purpose of the delivery of enhancements.
* Lead the execution and delivery of digital solution pilots and explorations by defining scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, milestones, and success criteria; mobilizing cross-functional teams; coordinating vendor onboarding; monitoring dependencies, actions, risks, issues, and costs; providing transparent status reporting; and escalating decisions or barriers to ensure timely, high-quality delivery
* Lead the translation of business strategy, operational needs, and stakeholder requirements into digital capability requirements and roadmaps, ensuring organizational, regional, and process alignment.
* Facilitate the prioritization of demand, managing competing interests with objective assessment of value. Ensure that priorities are aligned to organizational priorities. Create transparency into priorities with clear communication to stakeholders. Translate priorities into plans in collaboration with the development team. Manage expectations with stakeholders.
* Provide business leadership for the development of business requirements, as well as hands-on authoring, ensuring requirements appropriately address business outcomes, process needs, compliance considerations, data requirements, and intended value.
* Participate with the implementation team in sprint planning, sprint testing, and SDLC testing.
* Oversee and direct UAT and business testing, partnering with the business lead on the testing strategy and approach, establishing a UAT plan, mobilizing the UAT team, overseeing scripting, and coordinating UAT activities within the framework of the implementation plan.
* Ensure that all digital capabilities have a defined business process, partnering with the GCO business lead.
* As part of requirement gathering, ensure that related business processes are well defined and probe into process optimization or process solutions where appropriate, to complement digital solutioning. In cases where process or process ownership is not defined, create process flows aligned with proper functions and leadership.
* Define and articulate the value proposition of all requests, in both quantifiable and qualitative categories.
* Define, track and share business outcome value measures for digital projects.
* Represent GCO business interests as a key member of the implementation team.
* Review proposed designs to ensure that solutions are architected to meet the actual need and expected value. Ensure data are fit for intended decision-making.
* Drive business demand prioritization within assigned capability areas, balancing business value, risk, strategic alignment, dependencies, and resource constraints in partnership with product and technology teams. Own curation of backlog.
* Partner with business lead to ensure appropriate change management and business adoption plans are in place.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry solutions, and vendor capabilities and provide recommendations to GCO leadership regarding adoption, investment, experimentation, and scale-up.

The incumbent will work directly with GCO clinical stakeholders, Development and IT organizations and support implementing novel technology solutions.

**Essential Functions of the job:**

General expectations of a **Digital Clinical Operations** employee

* Forge relationships with users to understand their requirements and processes, identify automation opportunities, collaborate with development/vendor team to create the necessary fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Project Management: ensure forward progress, timelines are managed, accountabilities are clear, and project risks and costs are managed.
* Drive the analysis of the technology and industry trends to identify specific opportunities that ensure BeOne clinical trials and operations are conducted with fit-for-purpose, cost-effective and innovative solutions that are cohesive, efficient, reliable, and compliant with all applicable regulatory expectations.
* Implement the GCO technology roadmap to increase Global Clinical Operations’ productivity, reduce rising costs of clinical trials, and reduce clinical trial inefficiencies
* Monitor, evaluate, and optimize the performance and quality of the technology solutions, as well as troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise
* Promote a culture that exemplifies agility, compliance, process-orientation, data-driven decision-making, and thoughtful use of technology and innovation
* Partner with internal BeOne departments, including Development Data Science, QA and IT, to support the development of documentation associated with computerized systems, including lifecycle management for existing systems, and the implementation of innovative new systems
* Develop solution requirements and standards in alignment with stakeholders (Clinical Operations, Data Management, Supply Chain, etc.).
* Identify pain points and manual workflows, and develop technological solutions that address these challenges, leveraging existing and innovative approaches.
* Take accountability for business value realization of technology solutions. Ensure that appropriate change tactics are planned and effectively delivered (communications, training, user communities, adoption drives) for both internal and external users. May directly involve development and delivery of these tactics.
* Focus on user expectation and satisfaction and decreasing user burden. Proactively ensure system usability and user needs remain a high priority.

**Supervisory** **Responsibilities:**

* Be an individual contributor
* Provide functional leadership to analysts, consultants, vendors, and matrixed project resources supporting assigned digital initiatives. Provide coaching, direction, and subject-matter guidance while establishing clear accountability for deliverables and outcomes.

**Technical Skills:**

* Requirement gathering and documentation
* Technical solution project management
* Process modeling
* Familiarity with clinical operations applications in the financial space

**Soft skills:**

* **Stakeholder management**: Ability to work collaboratively with functional leadership and external partners, to forge partnerships and collaborations arrangements. Ability to manage expectations, to communicate to broad groups of end-users.
* **Project management leadership**: Ability to build alignment, influence without direct authority, foster accountability, navigate competing priorities, adapt to change, and maintain constructive collaboration and forward momentum across cross-functional teams.
* **Communication**: Exhibits strong cross-cultural awareness, and strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey complex insights to non-technical stakeholders
* **Cross-functional oversight:** Ability to collaborate with cross-functional clinical teams to understand their business needs and deliver outcome-aligned solutions. Partner with internal BeiGene departments, including Development Data Science, QA and IT, to develop standards, policies, and procedures associated with computerized systems, including lifecycle management for existing systems, and the implementation of innovative new systems.
* **Problem-Solving**: Excellent conceptual, analytical, and problem-solving skills to identify trends and make data-driven decisions. Troubleshooting skills.

* **Able to drive forward progress**
* **Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment**, and able to adapt to changes in responsibilities and workloads

**Required experience:**

* Clinical Operations domain experience – working in Biotech, life sciences or IT consulting industry
* Bachelor’s degree Computer Science, Life Sciences, Business or related degree required
* Minimum 7+ years in translating business needs into technology solutions with a proven record
* Minimum 2 years in driving execution and delivery of solutions
* Investigator fee management systems (CMS, ERP, budgeting systems, payment systems, financial analytics, forecasting, accruals)
* Budgeting, contracting, payment expertise in the context of clinical trials
* Core clinical systems (CTMS, eDC, IRT)
* SDLC
* Validated systems
* Project management experience is a plus
* Business analysis experience is a plus
* Familiarity with data processing / engineering is a plus

**Travel:** As needed

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

* Fosters Teamwork
* Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
* Self-Awareness
* Acts Inclusively
* Demonstrates Initiative
* Entrepreneurial Mindset
* Continuous Learning
* Embraces Change
* Results-Oriented
* Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
* Financial Excellence
* Communicates with Clarity

890c4066a2925e0d944c.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Manager of Specialty Operations to support the operational execution of our new specialty product launch. This role will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy, and patient support operations for a rare disease product, with an initial focus on the successful commercialization of the new product launch. The role will also collaborate closely with Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure a seamless patient and provider experience.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Specialty Distribution Partner Management:**

* Support day-to-day operational execution across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services, ensuring coordination with internal teams and timely escalation of operational barriers.Partner with vendor program managers across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services to support operational activities, monitor open issues, and facilitate timely issue resolution and follow-up actions.

* Monitor and maintain operational performance standards with specialty distribution partners, ensuring alignment with agreed-upon service levels, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate resolution of operational barriers involving prescription processing, medical benefit reimbursement, buy-and-bill, institutional procurement, billing and claims, and alignment of product delivery with treatment scheduling, engaging appropriate functional experts as needed. Create and manage various channel/SD/SP communications and documents

* Work closely with the Channel Operations team to monitor/maintain optimal inventory levels.

* Support the maintenance, implementation, and periodic review of established business rules and operational procedures with specialty distribution partners.

* Contribute to development of product and channel specific contract strategies

  
  

**Collaboration with Internal Stakeholders:**

* Coordinate operational activities across the vendor program manager, Access Strategy, Patient Services, Trade & Distribution, Data & Analytics, and field leadership.

* Maintain documented responsibilities and handoffs, and route strategic, policy, and customer-facing decisions to the accountable function. Work cross-functionally with Market Access on product access issues and Medical team on resource development and pull-through.

* Develop relationships and work closely with the Patient Services team and/or Field Reimbursement Managers to help resolve patient/ provider access issues.

* Provide regular updates regarding partner performance, patient access issues, and any operational challenges, continuously evolving/challenging our support model with learnings related to medical/pharmacy benefit coverage learnings

* Collaborate with the team to continuously improve patient services and operational processes, including reviewing and optimizing workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

  
  

**Issue Investigation & Resolution:**

* Take ownership of investigating operational issues and work with internal and external teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

* Address challenges related to patient enrollment, medication distribution, insurance verification, or other issues impacting pharmacy operations.

* Escalate critical issues as needed and ensure effective communication with all relevant parties to resolve problems quickly and efficiently.

  
  

**Reporting & Data Analysis:**

* Identify appropriate metrics and tracking to ensure the right execution and success; analyze procedure volume, trends and growth for the specialty channel.

* Compile operational metrics, document performance trends, and provide reporting support for management reviews and business update meetings. Provide regular reports on operational performance, issue resolution, and process improvements to the Director of Specialty Operations.

* Analyze specialty reporting and work with data and analytics team to create patient, provider, physician, pharmacy and payer data dashboards in order to help improve processes

* Monitor specialty distributor/pharmacy data (ie; Time to First Fill, Conversion Rate, Gap days and Adherence)

  
  

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in regular process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing specialty distribution network operations and enhancing the patient experience.

* Provide input into the development and refinement of training materials, operational procedures, and best practices for working with specialty pharmacy partners.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, including hands-on management of specialty partner operations, patient services, and complex access workflows. Demonstrated experience coordinating hub, specialty pharmacy, and specialty distribution services and managing vendor performance is required.

* Experience with medical benefit therapies, institutional delivery, and launch implementation is preferred.

* Experience evaluating data sources for insights, specifically specialty distribution and patient services data.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* Pharmacy experience preferred

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.
