e908019e496ef978a0da.title: Customer Experience Manager
e908019e496ef978a0da.description:
**What is Reach Financial?**

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

Reach Financial launched in 2015 and has helped our customers pay off over $1 billion in debt. We offer debt consolidation loans and personal loans; together, these markets represent a $1.5T opportunity. In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

**About the Role**

The Customer Experience Manager leads frontline operations, ensuring the effective execution of departmental strategies, achievement of performance goals, and alignment with organizational priorities.

This role is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing Team Leads, overseeing employee performance management, maintaining quality and compliance standards, and optimizing workforce management. The Customer Experience Manager reports directly to the Director of Customer Experience.

**What You Will Do**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop Team Leads and Operations Specialists through biweekly 1:1s.
* Drive the weekly Team Lead meeting on performance trends, process fixes, and training gaps.

* Oversee formal corrective action and performance improvement plans in partnership with People & Culture, including appropriate documentation and escalation.
* Complete Team Lead reviews and support under-performing agent coaching.

**Operations & Workforce Management**

* Own daily operational execution, workload prioritization, scheduling, coverage, PTO, and timecard approvals. Delegate routine monitoring and follow-through to Team Leads.
* Assess demand, capacity, adherence, and coverage risks. Recommend staffing changes to the Director, who retains ownership of staffing forecasts and headcount decisions.
* Resolve second-level customer and operational escalations, document outcomes, and coordinate root-cause remediation with relevant partners.
* Maintain accurate procedures and knowledge resources. Obtain required approvals before publishing policy changes and coordinate training and implementation.

**Quality & Compliance**

* Calibrate QA scoring across the three teams, spot-check calls and emails for required disclosures, UDAAP language, and script adherence per bank partner expectations.
* Coordinate with Compliance, QA, and the Director to investigate exceptions, implement corrective actions, and verify remediation. Escalate significant customer, compliance, or operational risks promptly.

**Reporting & Performance**

* Own departmental KPI performance, including volume, abandon rate, QA, CSAT, AHT, ACW, Speed to Answer and Adherence.
* Validate and consolidate Team Lead reporting, maintain scorecards, and provide the Director with actionable findings, risks, and recommendations. Partner with relevant teams to resolve operational dependencies.
* Own performance improvement for quality, customer treatment, productivity, and employee development measures.
* Validate bonus calculations and supporting data, resolve discrepancies, and submit accurate results to designated recipients within established deadlines.

**What You Should Have**

* At least three years of customer service experience, including two years in a supervisory role, with demonstrated ownership of team performance and operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, evaluate coaching effectiveness, administer corrective action with People & Culture, and maintain employee engagement.
* Experience in consumer loan servicing, working knowledge of UDAAP, regulatory complaint handling, and bank partner compliance expectations.
* Experience with workforce management and contact center tools (e.g., Amazon Connect, Salesforce, Rippling).
* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills, including the ability to identify root causes, manage competing priorities, and drive actions to completion.

**What is it like working at Reach Financial?**

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.

We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

**What benefits will you receive?**

* Healthcare, Life Insurance, 401k Match
* Paid Time Off, Paid 12-week Parental Leave
* Disability (short-term, long-term), Employee Assistance Program
* Spending Accounts (Transit/Parking, Medical, Dependent Care)
* Insurance Discounts (home, auto, pet)

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 95,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

769c4828771ff757d955.description:
**Who We Are**

Catalis is a leading government Software as a Service (SaaS) and integrated payments provider, powering a wide range of government operations at the municipal, county, state, and federal levels. Our innovative solutions are designed to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and improve the delivery of government services to the public. At Catalis, we are committed to leveraging technology to make government interactions simpler, faster, and more accessible.

  
  

**The Opportunity**

As a Support Manager at Catalis, you will play a vital role in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our existing clients with the use of our products/services. Your primary focus will be to facilitate resolution of any technical or workflow issues with our products. By understanding their business objectives, aligning our solutions to their needs, facilitating meaningful engagements, validating outcomes, you will drive value delivery and gain referenceable customers for new clients. You will have direct reports in this role that you will mentor, train with best practices on working with our customers for a superior customer experience.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

This role includes supporting multiple product lines with staff located both locally and remotely. He/she will be responsible for leading and directing a team of software support analysts who support direct client interactions. This leader will have a history of demonstrated strength in multi-site customer service leadership, team leadership, process deployment, leveraging technology in Customer Service, Salesforce CRM, and process improvement.

  
  

The Support Manager provides overall direction and guidance for all customer service people, systems, and workflows. This includes technical expertise and managing a growing customer service team; designing and optimizing customer service process workflows; designing and implementing programs to optimize customer service efficiencies; and managing CRM reporting tools.

  
  

The Support Manager will demonstrate superior leadership skills, work well with a team, work with all levels of management, and can work independently with little or no supervision. The Support Manager must have superior decision-making skills, problem-solving skills, and conflict-management abilities. He/she must have a have deep experience in CRM, reporting, process improvement, and be able to design programs that will drive success through distribution

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead multi-site customer service organization, including day to day leadership, talent management, and staffing.

0cab67b247a2a7d84bda.title: Customer Success Manager - Remote
0cab67b247a2a7d84bda.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

Steer is looking for a Customer Success Manager to build strong relationships with automotive shop owners and managers and help them get measurable value from our products. You will own an assigned portfolio, guide customers after onboarding, address risks early, and identify opportunities to support their growth. This role combines proactive account management with responsive, dependable customer communication.  
  
**Compensation: $80,000 - $90,000 base + 15% bonus.**

**You Are**

* **A Relationship Builder:** You are a proactive account owner who builds deep trust with shop owners, managers, and day-to-day operational contacts.
* **Comfortable Managing a Portfolio:** You thrive when balancing customer needs, competing priorities, and proactive outreach across a varied book of business.
* **A Structure Builder:** You are energized by the "grey area" and enjoy creating order. You want to help improve the customer success playbook while consistently executing on customer commitments.
* **Commercially Minded & Composed:** You are highly organized, focused on driving business value, and able to remain calm under pressure while balancing customer advocacy with internal capacity.

**You Will**

* **Own the Customer Lifecycle:** Manage ongoing customer relationships after onboarding, including proactive check-ins, business reviews, renewal readiness, and expansion identification.
* **Strengthen the CS Playbook:** Help improve how Steer proactively supports customers through consistent touchpoints, clear follow-up, and repeatable account management practices.
* **Champion Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Support, Onboarding, Product, Sales, and RevOps to resolve customer issues and translate feedback into clear internal next steps.
* **Mitigate Risk & Drive Growth:** Maintain visibility into account health, identify revenue risks early, and take action to improve retention and uncover relevant expansion opportunities.
* **Ensure Consistent Execution:** Lead smooth onboarding transitions, help customers connect product capabilities to their goals, and keep account records and commitments current. Respond promptly and keep customers informed through resolution.

**You Have**

***Must Have***

* **Customer Relationship Experience:** 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role, with ownership of ongoing customer relationships.
* **Commercial Acumen:** A track record of supporting customer retention and identifying growth opportunities. You can connect product value to customer business goals and navigate conversations about risk, renewals, and expansion.
* **Clear Communication & Follow-Through:** Strong presentation, organization, and relationship skills, with the ability to lead productive customer conversations, set clear expectations, and consistently deliver on commitments.
* **Lifecycle Ownership:** Experience managing post-sale customer needs, including adoption, account health, issue resolution, and coordination across internal teams.

***Nice to Have***

* **Industry Experience:** Familiarity with automotive, franchise, or Multi-Shop Operator (MSO) business models.
* **CS Ecosystem Tech:** Experience using HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, or dedicated Customer Success platforms.
* **Process Improvement:** Experience supporting SMB or mid-market SaaS customers, improving customer onboarding or engagement processes, or working with marketing SaaS, integrations, or business phone products.

  

#### 

**Interview Process:**

1. Recruiting screen - 20 min  
2. Hiring manager interview - 45 min  
3. Assignment/Case Study - 1hr  
4. Problem Solving Exercise - 1hr  
5. Reference check

  

**We Offer**

* 100% remote work environment
* Medical, Dental and Vision insurance within 30 days
* 100% employer-paid medical insurance
* Equity package
* Flexible PTO with 15 days minimum
* Generous Parental Leave
* FSA and HSA options
* 401(k)
* Growth & Wellness Stipend
* WFH Equipment
* Chance to work with the latest technology
* A collaborative, high ownership culture
* Opportunities for development and career growth

**Why Join Steer?**  
  
At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.  
  
  
  
  
We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

8521d9dac021d2df8a33.description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

  

**Job Introduction:**
  
  
The Customer Success Manager is responsible for managing relationships with assigned customers to ensure adoption, satisfaction, and retention of the company’s solutions. This role serves as the primary point of contact for day-to-day engagement, helping customers achieve value from their investment while identifying opportunities for growth. The Customer Success Manager partners with Sales, Product, and Support teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
  
  

* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders.
* Develop success plans to ensure customers achieve desired outcomes with company solutions.
* Monitor account health metrics, identify risks, and proactively address adoption challenges.
* Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews with customers to share insights and progress.
* Collaborate with Sales on renewals and expansion opportunities.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to provide customer feedback and advocate for enhancements.
* Resolve escalated issues by coordinating with cross-functional teams.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, issues, and progress in CRM systems.
* Contribute to the development of customer success best practices and playbooks.

  
**Basic Qualifications:**
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 5–7 years of experience in customer success, account management, or related role.
* Strong relationship-building and communication skills with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Experience managing customer portfolios in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Proficiency with CRM and customer success platforms (Salesforce, Gainsight, or equivalent).
* Ability to analyze customer data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Strong problem-solving and organizational skills.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  
  

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

  

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options
* 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage
* Great benefits including unlimited PTO, parental leave and free snacks and beverages
* The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies
* Be part of an early stage, hyper-growth start-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper
* Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up
* A dynamic work environment with a strong sense of community and collaboration
* The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy
* Exciting opportunities for career growth and development

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

500a3ce5076259e7bee0.description:
**Positition:**

The Order Resolution Program Manager builds and leads the Order Resolution Program (ORP), a national program that helps ensure patients receive the testing their physicians have ordered. When an order encounters a barrier, such as an unreachable patient, an incorrect phone number, a patient with unanswered questions about their test, or a step that requires clinic involvement, this role makes sure the right people take the right action so care is not delayed. Many of these patients are navigating a cancer diagnosis, and the program exists to support them and the Patient Coordinators who care for them.

As the *program's founding owner*, the Program Manager exercises independent judgment to assess the current landscape, resolve complex cases directly, and determine what the program needs to succeed, including whether and how to expand the team. The role is hands-on by design: the Program Manager works open cases alongside Patient Coordinators to understand where and why orders stall, then uses that firsthand insight and program data to set strategy, define standards, and guide leadership decisions.

The Program Manager partners across Patient Services, Territory Managers, Clinical Oncology Specialists, Patient Coordinators, Inside Sales Managers, Regional Directors, and Operations Managers, earning alignment through expertise and sound judgment rather than direct authority.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Program Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the Order Resolution Program end-to-end across all national regions, independently assessing the current landscape, including case volume, root causes, regional variation, and existing workflows, to determine where patient orders are most at risk of delay.
* Develop a data-supported program roadmap and staffing recommendation for Patient Services leadership, including headcount requirements, staffing structure, timeline, and whether process or tooling solutions would better serve patients.
* Define the program operating model, including case ownership, escalation criteria, service timelines, handoff protocols, and quality standards, and adjust it as the program matures.
* Lead the design of the team structure, role definitions, hiring profile, onboarding, and performance expectations for future team members.

**Case Resolution & Patient Care Support**

* Exercise independent judgment to evaluate open ORP cases, determine the root cause of each barrier, and develop a tailored resolution strategy that accounts for the clinical context, the patient's circumstances, and available resources.
* Work complex and high-priority cases directly, including researching LIMS, paper orders, and patient outreach tools to locate missing or updated contact information, and decide whether a case calls for administrative resolution, clinic education or engagement, or escalation.
* Partner with Patient Coordinators to support patient outreach, providing guidance on how to approach each case and, where appropriate, connecting with patients directly so that questions about their orders are answered and care can move forward.
* Determine when to escalate a case to the clinic, engage the field team, or close it, and document the rationale so any subsequent owner can continue seamlessly.
* Maintain a real-time view of all open cases, including status, owner, next action, and age, and follow up consistently to confirm actions are completed and patients are not left waiting.

**Analytics & Performance Reporting**

* Design, build, and maintain the ORP reporting infrastructure, including dashboards, KPI scorecards, and regional trend analysis, and define the metrics used to measure program success.
* Report regularly to Patient Services leadership on case volume, resolution rates, time to resolution, and order completion outcomes, translating data into clear insights about what is working, what is not, and what should change.
* Analyze recurring barriers, such as common reasons patients cannot be reached or questions that arise repeatedly, and develop recommendations that reduce the number of patients whose orders require intervention in the first place.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Process Improvement**

* Partner with Territory Managers, Clinical Oncology Specialists, Associate Clinical Oncology Specialists, and Patient Coordinators to set clear expectations, communicate promptly, and share accountability on every open case.
* Partner with Inside Sales Managers, Regional Directors, and Operations Managers to align program priorities, resolve regional barriers, and ensure teams understand their role in supporting patient orders.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for ORP, providing guidance and consultation to field and operations partners and developing best practices, training, and standard work that can be adopted nationally.
* Identify systemic process gaps and bring structured, data-backed recommendations to leadership, including changes to workflows, status definitions, tooling, and cross-team handoffs, with the patient experience as the guiding lens.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, life sciences, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience in a role requiring independent judgment, program ownership, and decision-making in a healthcare or clinical operations environment.
* 5 or more years of experience in healthcare operations, patient services, program or project management, or a comparable environment, with demonstrated ownership of a program, workflow, or initiative from assessment through execution.
* Demonstrated ability to assess a complex operating landscape, identify root causes, and develop and present a data-supported recommendation, including resourcing and staffing needs, to senior leadership.
* Proven ability to independently assess multi-variable situations and determine the appropriate course of action without direct supervision, particularly in patient-facing or clinically sensitive contexts.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive accountability across cross-functional teams, including field, sales, and operations leaders, without direct authority.
* Strong analytical capability, including building performance reporting, interpreting trends, and communicating findings clearly to leadership; advanced MS Excel or equivalent skills required.
* Experience in a call center, patient outreach, or high-volume case management environment (inbound and outbound).
* Proficiency in CRM platforms, case tracking systems, and data tools; familiarity with skip tracing tools and LIMS is a strong plus.
* Prior experience leading, coaching, or building a team is preferred. Background in patient coordination or another patient-facing healthcare role is strongly preferred.

  

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

**Technical**

* Program and project management expertise, including scoping, planning, prioritization, milestone tracking, and stakeholder management.
* Specialized knowledge of healthcare operations, patient services workflows, and clinical coordination sufficient to evaluate case scenarios and develop resolution strategies without relying on standardized scripts.
* Advanced proficiency in CRM platforms, case tracking systems, and reporting tools, with the ability to design KPI dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into program performance and patient order outcomes.
* Strong quantitative skills, including comfort working with large data sets to identify trends, build business cases, and model staffing and capacity needs.
* Experience with skip tracing tools and multi-database research methods, and with process documentation and standard operating procedure development.

**Behavioral**

* Exercises sound, independent judgment consistently, treating each case and each program decision as a situation requiring individualized analysis.
* Builds before being asked: sees what a new program needs, takes ownership of the decision, and moves forward without waiting to be told something is off track.
* Balances urgency and care: moves quickly because patients are waiting, and makes thoughtful decisions because the stakes are real.
* Thinks like a program owner and acts like a teammate: comfortable working individual cases to learn the work, and equally comfortable stepping back to set strategy and advise leadership.
* Earns credibility with cross-functional partners through expertise, clear communication, and follow-through, and uses it to drive action across teams they do not directly control.
* Coaches and develops others, and is ready to build and lead a team as the program grows.

  

**Physical Demands & Work Environment:**

* This is a primarily remote position. Occasional on-site attendance may be required for planning sessions, leadership reviews, or business needs.
* Duties are performed in a home office or professional office setting and require the ability to use a computer keyboard, communicate over the telephone, and read printed and digital material.
* This role may require working outside standard business hours at times to address time-sensitive case situations or program needs.

**Travel:**

Minimal travel required. Occasional travel (estimated less than 15%) may be required for national leadership meetings, regional business reviews, or planning sessions.

**OUR OPPORTUNITY**

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

*If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.*

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

0bac064d3ebaec9a1bf6.title: Project Stakeholder Engagement Coordinator
0bac064d3ebaec9a1bf6.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Project Stakeholder Engagement Coordinator supports enterprise-level outreach and engagement for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. The role coordinates in-person, virtual, and hybrid activities that help Veterans, family members, caregivers, VA clinicians, staff, leaders, and other stakeholders understand and use connected care resources.  
The Project Stakeholder Engagement Coordinator carries out the day-to-day execution of DRHCI project stakeholder engagements under the direction of the Stakeholder Engagement Enterprise Lead. This position runs partner outreach and meeting logistics, operates the recurring process for collecting frontline challenges, builds and maintains the searchable problem repository, prepares engagement materials, plans and runs engagement events, and tracks and reports engagement activity for the project and supports strategy, senior relationships, informs designs governance, and executes what the Lead designs.  
The Coordinator combines audience and event research, stakeholder coordination, event logistics, outreach delivery, and feedback analysis. Working with contractor leadership, designated VA stakeholders, and event partners, the Coordinator provides a consistent, welcoming, accessible experience and brings stakeholder insights back to the teams responsible for program improvements.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Maintains the integrated engagement calendar and tracker, and drafts and updates sections of the DRHCI Stakeholder Engagement Plan under the Lead's direction.
* Conducts day-to-day outreach to industry partners, VSOs, academic institutions, and local health organizations: schedules meetings and workshops, prepares agendas and materials, records outcomes, follows up on actions, and maintains stakeholder contact lists.
* Drafts materials for national calls that showcase projects, gauge demand, and gather feedback, along with cheat sheets and one-pagers, for Lead approval and in coordination with the Communications Specialist.
* Operates the recurring frontline-challenge process: issues requests to Innovation Specialists and facilities, logs submissions, validates them with submitters, tracks follow-up, and keeps submitted needs current.
* Builds, populates, tags, and maintains the searchable repository of frontline problems according to the Lead's governance rules, aligns problems with proposed or existing vendor solutions, and keeps entries current.
* Maintains the VSO feedback loop: records VSO-identified problems, tracks their status, and drafts updates on how problems are being addressed for Lead approval.
* Prepares and runs logistics for engagement with the field-based Innovation Specialists on the Lead's cadence, including materials, scheduling, and follow-up.
* Plans and runs logistics for hackathons, innovation fairs, and networking events: registration, venue or virtual platform, agenda, materials, travel, and post-event follow-up.
* Tracks engagement and socialization activity, compiles participation, interaction, and feedback data, and drafts the Stakeholder Engagement Impact Report for Lead review.
* Maintains stakeholder engagement SOPs, toolkits, templates, checklists, and lessons learned in approved repositories.
* Coordinates with the Communications Specialist so engagement materials carry consistent messaging, and with the Project Stakeholder Engagement Coordinator so project-level insight feeds the enterprise repository.
* Coordinates with technical, data, and privacy staff to obtain accurate technical content for engagement materials. Leadership Expectations

This position has no formal supervisory responsibility. The Coordinator is expected to take ownership of assigned engagements, establish trust quickly, anticipate logistical challenges, and communicate clearly with participants, partners, and leadership.  
The role may coordinate the activities of assigned event personnel, subcontractor representatives, or local support staff. Decisions involving additional spending, changes in scope, staffing commitments, or public messaging must follow established approval processes.  
For assigned DRHCI activities, the Coordinator maintains the enterprise engagement approach and frontline problem repository in coordination with the designated stakeholder engagement lead. The role coordinates contributions from field staff, project teams, and communications colleagues without supervisory authority over them.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Three or more years in stakeholder engagement, outreach, partnership coordination, or comparable external-facing program work.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating stakeholder outreach and meetings across organizations with no shared reporting line.
* Experience planning and running convening events (workshops, conferences, fairs, or comparable), including logistics, agenda, and follow-through.
* Experience building and maintaining a tracked repository or database with consistent tagging and ownership, using SharePoint, Teams, or comparable platforms.
* Experience gathering stakeholder feedback and preparing concise summaries, recommendations, or after-action reports.

87200c6b2bc53aab9e0c.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Zillow’s Workforce Management team helps our customer-facing teams deliver reliable, efficient service to customers and partners. We connect workforce planning with day-to-day operations, aligning staffing and resources with service needs and business priorities. Through close collaboration with operations teams, we improve resource utilization, strengthen the customer experience, and build workforce practices that can scale with the business.

**About the role**
------------------

As Manager, Workforce Planning, you’ll lead a team of resource planning analysts to help achieve service-level and operational efficiency goals. You’ll shape workforce planning strategies, optimize staffing resources, and develop a team structure built for agility and scale.

Partnering across operations, you’ll translate data into actionable recommendations, strengthen workforce planning practices, and develop the team’s skills and expertise. Your work will help improve customer and partner experiences while positioning workforce planning as a trusted source of insight across the organization.

You will get to:

* Lead and develop a team of analysts by setting meaningful goals and providing coaching that advances their skills, expertise, and business understanding.
* Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute a resource planning strategy that improves staffing utilization and cost efficiency while supporting positive customer and partner experiences.
* Support consistent service-level performance by providing partners with accurate, timely, and actionable insights for strategic and tactical decisions.
* Build relationships with internal and external partners, communicate workforce planning recommendations, and demonstrate their business value.
* Improve workforce planning tools, including the administration and optimization of the Aspect workforce management platform, to strengthen operational effectiveness.
* Establish operating procedures, expand effective use of workforce management tools, and incorporate automation and AI-assisted processes in workforce management operations

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $97,400.00 - $155,600.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $92,600.00 - $147,800.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* An experienced workforce planning professional with demonstrated expertise and a track record of delivering results.
* Bring 8+ years of leadership experience in workforce planning or contact center operations.
* Hold a bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Resource Operations, Finance, or a related quantitative field, or have equivalent experience.
* Have a track record of leading remote teams effectively and fostering collaboration in a distributed work environment.
* Have experience implementing workforce planning programs and administering workforce management platforms.
* Communicate clearly and persuasively, with the ability to present recommendations and influence partners at multiple levels.
* Bring advanced analytical and reporting skills and can work independently in ambiguous, evolving environments.
Are able to travel when appropriate to attend meetings and business reviews.  

Preferred Qualifications

* Leadership experience focused on resource management and real-time operations.
* Experience administering Alvaria/Aspect workforce management platforms.
* Experience using Tableau, Salesforce, Zendesk, and Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.

**Get to know us**

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

3a066a83d3d939285d63.title: Senior Program Manager - Incident Coordinator
3a066a83d3d939285d63.description:
About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.  
Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States  
Overview:

GitHub is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator to independently coordinate complex, high-risk and business-critical customer situations within the Incident Coordination team’s remit.

Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator provides leadership during urgent customer-impacting incidents, creating clarity in ambiguous situations, establishing ownership and aligning Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Reliability Engineering, Customer Success and other stakeholders around a clear path forward.

This role requires excellent judgement, composure and the ability to influence without direct authority. The Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator must be able to manage several competing workstreams, make explicit prioritization decisions and communicate complex technical situations clearly to customers, senior leaders and technical stakeholders.

The role extends beyond coordinating individual incidents. Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinators use evidence from incidents and escalations to identify recurring risks, recommend improvements and deliver agreed changes within the incident coordination remit. They partner with accountable teams on broader product, support-process and customer-experience improvements.

Success is measured through effective incident coordination, sound prioritisation, timely and accurate customer communication, reliable handovers and follow-through on agreed actions. The role also contributes to shared improvements that reduce repeat customer impact, avoidable urgent demand and preventable executive escalations.

Responsibilities:

Strategic incident leadership

* Independently lead complex, high-risk customer incidents, prioritising by impact, urgency and risk.

* Create clarity and momentum when cause, ownership, recovery path or customer outcome is uncertain.

* Own coordination, communication, action tracking and handovers across the incident lifecycle.

* Establish clear technical ownership and coordinate workstreams, decisions, risks, dependencies and next steps. Engineering and Support remain accountable for technical decisions, remediation and resource commitments.

* Exercise sound judgement, challenge assumptions and adapt the response as evidence changes.

* Make competing priorities and trade-offs explicit, engaging specialist support or accountable leaders when needed.

Cross-functional leadership and influence

* Bring together the required internal teams and Microsoft partners to coordinate an effective response.

* Align stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities and perspectives.

* Influence technical owners, senior stakeholders and partners without relying on direct authority.

* Resolve unclear ownership, identify alternative paths and escalate proportionately while maintaining productive relationships.

* Drive timely decisions, confirm accountable owners and track actions, risks and dependencies to completion.

* Act as a trusted operational adviser during executive-visible and high-pressure situations.

Customer and executive communication

* Translate complex technical information into concise, accurate and business-relevant updates.

* Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses, risks and unknowns.

* Set an effective communication cadence and tailor detail to each audience.

* Avoid speculation, unsupported recovery estimates and unrealistic commitments.

* Provide coordination and clarity on customer calls, managing expectations and supporting de-escalation.

* Lead difficult conversations while balancing customer advocacy with technical and operational constraints.

* Maintain stakeholder confidence while protecting responders from unnecessary distraction.

Incident intelligence and repeat-failure reduction

* Identify recurring patterns and systemic risks across incidents, customers, products and processes.

* Use evidence to define clear problems, insights and recommendations.

* Lead post-incident reviews focused on ownership, prevention and operational improvement.

* Agree corrective and preventative actions, owners and expected outcomes with accountable teams.

* Track significant actions to completion, acceptance or formal disposition, escalating stalled or unowned risks.

* Evaluate whether improvements reduce repeat incidents, customer impact and avoidable escalations.

Organisational and operational improvement

* Lead incident-coordination improvement projects and partner with accountable teams to implement agreed changes.

* Use incident and customer-impact evidence to influence product, engineering and operational priorities.

* Improve coordination processes, tooling, ownership, communication, handovers and disengagement practices.

* Identify automation and AI opportunities that increase consistency, effectiveness and scale.

* Develop outcome measures that show customer impact, operational risk and improvement progress.

* Create reusable operating practices, clarify ownership and share learning with partner teams.

Capability building

* Build and apply expertise across incident workflows and relevant product areas to clarify customer impact and support investigation.

* Train and onboard coordinators, sharing judgement and learning from complex incidents.

* Review incident communications, handovers and escalations to improve quality and consistency.

* Create reusable playbooks, standards and guidance that strengthen team capability without creating dependency on individuals.

* Share learning with Support and partner teams to improve incident readiness and customer engagement.

* Partner with Engineering to document and follow up on incident-driven bugs and feature requests, communicating relevant outcomes to customers and responders.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years experience in technical customer support, technical writing, system administration, or related roles

  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical customer support, technical writing, system administration, or related roles
  + OR equivalent experience.

* Experience leading complex, high-impact incidents across multiple teams and stakeholder groups, creating clarity and momentum in ambiguous or rapidly changing situations.

* Experience making and defending difficult prioritization decisions based on customer impact, business and technical risk, entitlement, and available capacity.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including managing difficult customer and stakeholder conversations and communicating complex situations to senior leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven ability to influence decisions and drive cross-functional actions to measurable outcomes without direct authority.

* Experience leading high-profile, executive-visible customer incidents or escalations in a global technology organisation.

* Experience partnering across Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Security, Communications, and account teams.

* Experience identifying recurring incident patterns and using data and evidence to drive preventative, product, engineering, or operational improvements.

Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $50.10 - USD $132.89 /Hr.  
  
These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.  
GitHub Leadership Principles:

**GitHub values**

* Customer-obsessed
* Ship to learn
* Growth mindset
* Own the outcome
* Better together
* Diverse and inclusive

**Manager fundamentals**

* Model
* Coach
* Care

**Leadership principles**

* Create clarity
* Generate energy
* Deliver success

Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.  
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.  
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.  
EEO Statement: GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

**Position:** Store Manager
  
**Department:** Donated Goods Retail  
**Reports to:** Retail District Director  
**Status:** Exempt

Goodwill Keystone Area is committed to creating a culture of belonging where all people feel respected and valued. This is because we celebrate the diversity of thought, the richness of the human experience and the desire to reflect the communities we serve.

**Summary**  
Responsible for the management of a Goodwill store. Plan, coordinate, and direct the daily activities related to its successful operation and the achievement ensuring that the organization goals and objectives are accomplished. Provides leadership and ensures compliance to standards, financial performance, productivity and accountability.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Responsible for hiring, orientation, training, development, coaching, and termination of store staff. Ensures job descriptions are maintained and updated as well as establishes performance criteria. Promotes and models a team-based approach among staff and works across departments to support all aspects of employment at Goodwill. Ensures the proper coordination of clients assigned to the store. Communicates problems and concerns with Retail District Director (RDD) and/or Human Resources representative.
* Oversees and manages operations to ensure the following but not limited to:
  + Goodwill policies and procedures are communicated and enforced.
  + Sufficient daily inventory of raw donations to meet all store production goals.
  + Staff schedules in line with store staffing model and budgeting parameters.
  + Donor doors are open and able to accept donations during all business hours.
  + Appropriate and consistent use of SAP Warehouse Management System (WMS) to accurately account for and track containers by type of product (i.e. raw, processed, 2nd sort, etc.). Meet all system compliance standards.
  + Achievement of daily/weekly production and sales goals and utilization of SITW reports to continually monitor employees’ production against goals; adjusts production and other operational practices while maintaining efficiencies to meet goals by following all established standards and guidelines.
  + Identify ways to improve backroom operations, front end retail sales and other aspects of operations and discuss with senior management.
  + Know and understand all key metrics related to the store; work with RDD on developing enhance data analysis skills.
  + Maximize used goods processing through the proper application of GKA established techniques, including:
    - Sorting
    - Preparing and pricing items for sale
    - Meeting and exceeding production goals on a consistent basis
    - Consistent rotation of all merchandise in accordance with store rotation schedule.
    - Submission of high quality donations to Ecommerce.
    - Adhere to all guidelines for New Goods inventory tracking and management.
* Oversees all visual merchandising, cleanliness and organization of the sales floor to promote an attractive and convenient layout; ensures appropriate and timely use of all branded marketing materials and signage. This includes but is not limited to:
  + Maintain odor control of store.
  + Cash registers and rest rooms are in proper working order.
  + Maintain appearance of all areas of building exterior and landscape.
  + Maintain processing area appearance, housekeeping and work environment.
  + Identify structural concerns to discuss with the landlord and notify facilities team of all repairs and maintenance needs of the facility.
* Ensures that all paperwork is completed in an accurate and timely fashion to include, but not be limited to: new hire intake packet; payroll and production records, audit forms; payroll status and termination paperwork; and performance appraisals, etc.
* Serves as a role model, promotes a supportive culture, and ensures that store staff represent Goodwill in a positive manner by providing excellent customer service at all times both external and internal customers (i.e. coworkers, donors, shoppers).
* Ensures compliance with all asset protection policies and procedures; and proper cash handling including enforcement of cash register procedures and submission of required reports. Reports concerns and problems to RDD and Loss Prevention Department.
* Promotes an environment of workplace safety by training and informing others regarding safety standards/precautions. Monitors safety and takes corrective action. Assures that regulatory safety requirements are adhered to.
* Assists in the development of the annual budget. Effectively and efficiently manage the store budget including maintaining position control, achieving processing goals, generating revenue and controlling expenses. Tracks variances to budget and communicates reasons for variances to RDD.
* Supports and promotes organizational programs and special events, as required.
* Promotes an environment of workplace safety by training and informing others regarding safety standards/precautions. Monitors safety and takes corrective action. Assures that regulatory safety requirements are adhered to.
* Communicates progress, problems, and concerns to the Retail District Director.

**Company Description**

Founded in 1903, Waltron Bull & Roberts is one of the world's oldest manufacturers of water chemistry analytical instruments. Our products are used by power plants and industrial customers worldwide to monitor and control critical water chemistry parameters.

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Customer Support Manager** to lead our customer support activities from our headquarters in Flemington, New Jersey.

**Position Description**

This is a hands-on management position responsible for ensuring that customers receive timely, competent, and effective technical support for Waltron's analytical instruments.

The successful candidate will manage technical support cases from initial contact through resolution, coordinate resources across service, engineering, manufacturing, and sales, and help identify opportunities to improve product reliability and customer satisfaction.

The position requires strong organizational and communication skills, practical technical aptitude, and a disciplined approach to problem-solving.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage customer technical support requests, ensuring timely responses, appropriate prioritization, and effective resolution.
* Oversee the creation, documentation, follow-up, and closure of customer support cases in our CRM system.
* Provide initial technical troubleshooting and coordinate more complex investigations with field service and engineering personnel.
* Lead cross-functional discussions to resolve recurring or difficult technical problems.
* Ensure equipment failures and customer complaints are properly documented and addressed in accordance with company quality procedures.
* Coordinate field-service responses with the Service Manager and other company resources.
* Maintain clear, professional communication with customers throughout the resolution process.
* Monitor customer support performance, identify recurring problems, and recommend improvements to procedures, products, and service delivery.
* Work closely with Sales, Engineering, and Operations to ensure customer problems are resolved effectively and lessons learned are incorporated into company processes.

Qualifications

* At least three years of relevant experience in technical customer support, industrial equipment service, instrumentation, or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical problems systematically and coordinate their resolution.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to timely follow-through.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to customers.
* Experience with CRM or case management systems; Salesforce experience is desirable.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different functions.
* Familiarity with technical documentation, quality management systems, and structured corrective-action processes is desirable.
* Experience with analytical instrumentation, industrial process equipment, water treatment, or laboratory equipment is an advantage but not essential.

An engineering degree is not required. Relevant technical experience, sound judgment, and demonstrated problem-solving ability are more important.

As a veteran-owned small business, Waltron particularly values integrity, initiative, teamwork, and a strong service ethic. Military technical experience and community service are welcome qualifications.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual salary: $75,000-90,000, depending on experience.
* Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for subsidized medical, dental, and life insurance as well as the company 401k profit sharing plan.
* Full-time, permanent position based in Flemington, New Jersey.
* Travel to customer sites may be required.
* Relocation assistance is not available.

Please submit your resume and a brief description of your relevant technical and customer support experience through this job posting.

**General Description**

At iFLY, our mission is to deliver the dream of flight to everyone! A global company with almost 100 vertical wind tunnels in 19 countries (corporate and franchise), iFLY offers an exciting opportunity to join a successful and innovative organization that supports your professional growth.

As the Operations Manager, you will lead and inspire the team of instructors, customer service reps and STEM educators, ensure the tunnel is fully staffed at all times, enforce the highest standards of safety, deliver an unparalleled customer experience, ensure your tunnel shows as a premium venue, and support the General Manager as needed.

Your effective leadership will foster a collaborative atmosphere where all team members feel included and contribute to our company’s success. You will inspire each team member (Lead Instructor, Instructors, Customer Service Representatives, and Educators) to develop and grow to their full potential.

Every member of the iFLY Flight Crew embodies and delivers our core values of *SOAR*:

* **S**afety First – Commitment and continuous investment in Safety

* **O**utrageous Passion – Striving for excellence in all things iFLY

- **A**ccountability - Do what we say we’ll do (See it, Own it, Solve it)

* **R**espect – Embrace our differences and treat one another how we want to be treated

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Daily Operations:**

* Oversee and manage the day-to-day operations of the facility, ensuring seamless and efficient execution of all activities within the tunnel.
* Ensure the tunnel is fully always staffed.
* Create and manage daily flight and staff schedules to ensure optimal coverage and efficiency.
* Supervise instructors, CSRs and STEM educators, ensuring a high standard of customer service and professionalism.
* Lead, motivate, and support the team, focusing on development, conflict resolution, and overall team satisfaction. Inspire them to develop and grow to their full potential.
* Manage inventory control and ordering of supplies to ensure operational readiness.
* Manage and maintain daily reporting, including payroll and operational reports.
* Ensure your tunnel shows as a premium venue - clean, well-maintained, and presentable both inside and outside.
* Recruit, hire, train, develop and performance manage team members. Hire and develop the best team.
* Assist the General Manager as needed.

  

**Safety:**

* Uphold and enforce all safety guidelines and standards, ensuring a secure environment for both team members and customers.
* Perform regular safety audits and inspections to proactively identify and mitigate potential hazards.
* Ensure comprehensive and continuous training for all team members on safety protocols and emergency response procedures is completed.
* Respond swiftly and thoroughly to any safety concerns or incidents, maintaining the highest standards of safety.

  

**Work Experience and Knowledge Requirements**

* Proven experience in operations management, in a customer facing industry
* Strong leadership and team management skills
* Proficiency in monitoring various business metrics and developing plans to address any gaps
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly convey objectives while inspiring and guiding a diverse team
* Experience in talent acquisition, team development and training with proficiency in conducting performance-driven meetings and managing employee recognition and accountability programs
* A strong commitment to safety and a proven history of enforcing safety standards
* Detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Familiarity with Point-of-Sale systems

**Educational Background:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Bachelor’s degree preferred

  

**The Good Stuff**

* Competitive Salary and performance bonus opportunities
  + Salary Range: $60k - $65k
* Medical, dental, vision and supplemental plans
* Paid time off (PTO) and;
  + Parental Leave
  + Company Holidays
* 401k retirement investment
* Private Wellness Coaching
* Employee Assistance Programs (F2F counseling, financial coaching, legal counseling & mediation services)
* Tuition reimbursement
* Referral bonus program
* Employee discount on retail merchandise and flight packages
* Free flight time for team members and family
* Ongoing training and development programs

  

* This document is not an exhaustive list of every task this position will be asked or expected to perform. The primary responsibility of all iFLY Team Members is to prioritize their activities based on the needs of the business. As iFLY continues to grow and evolve, so will the duties of our Team Members

00c263c667682db28856.title: VP, Customer Care
00c263c667682db28856.description:
**Who we are:**  
Through a partnership-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. With an innovative quoting platform that delivers accurate pricing and bindable quotes in less than one minute, Coterie makes small business insurance effortless.  
  
We are on a mission to build and foster a world-class team to bring speed, simplicity, and service to commercial insurance. We value integrity, humility, passion, and intelligence. If you want to push yourself and reshape a $200B+ market, we’re excited to talk to you!

**Position Summary:**

The VP, Customer Care is the leader responsible for building and running the Service Center and the scalable Care Center around it: the organizational structure, leadership team, operating model, sourcing strategy, and technology foundation required to support the company’s growth. Reporting to executive leadership, this role ensures agents and policyholders receive consistent, high-quality experience while the operation grows efficiently and predictably.

This leader owns the Care Center budget and end-to-end service delivery across calls, chats, emails, and digital channels, supporting policy changes, endorsements, payments, renewals, claims inquiries, and escalations. A core part of the role is determining the right blend of in-house teams, outsourced partners, automation, and AI to deliver that service, in close partnership with Sales, Underwriting, Claims, Product, Technology, Procurement, and Compliance.

At Coterie, service is part of how we grow. Thousands of independent agents, brokers, and digital partners rely on us to make small business insurance easy, and every call, chat, and email either strengthens that relationship or puts it at risk. When an agent gets a fast, knowledgeable answer, they send us their next submission. When a policyholder who bought coverage through a partner has a smooth experience, they renew. The Care Center serves two audiences, agents and policyholders, each with different needs. Its performance shows up directly in retention, partner loyalty, and revenue.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement a scalable Care Center operating model, including organizational structure, support tiers, specialized queues (agent vs. policyholder, billing, claims inquiries, escalations), spans of control, and service level standards.
* Define roles, career paths, and the leadership hierarchy needed to grow volume and headcount without degrading service.
* Establish workforce management practices, including forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and staffing ratios, that flex with growth, seasonality, and new product launches.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing leadership team of directors and managers, including identifying talent, setting accountability through scorecards and goals, making difficult personnel decisions, and building succession plans for key roles.
* Build and launch the Service Center inside the Coterie Care Center, owning site and channel setup, systems readiness, and go-live, and hiring and training the founding team.
* Run day-to-day Service Center operations against clear performance standards (service level, handle time, quality, first-contact resolution, satisfaction), including real-time queue management, quality and coaching programs, and readiness for volume spikes from renewals, billing cycles, catastrophe events, and new product launches.
* Develop and maintain standardized processes, SOPs, escalation protocols, and knowledge management practices that keep the operation consistent across teams, locations, and partners.
* Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and executive dashboards, with a regular cadence of weekly operating metrics, monthly business reviews, and quarterly strategy reviews.
* Own the Care Center budget and serve as its primary point of accountability to executive leadership, reporting on performance, cost-to-serve, customer experience, emerging risks, and investment priorities.
* Develop and execute outsourcing strategy, including deciding which work stays in-house and which is outsourced (overflow, after-hours, seasonal peaks, back-office processing) based on complexity, regulatory risk, cost, and customer impact.
* Lead BPO partner selection, contracting, onboarding, and transition with Procurement, Legal, and Compliance, and hold partners to internal standards through SLAs, scorecards, business reviews, and audit rights.
* Identify and lead opportunities to apply self-service, automation, and AI to high-volume contact drivers, and measure the impact on containment, handle time, quality, cost-to-serve, and customer and agent satisfaction.
* Partner with Technology, Product, Security, and Compliance to evaluate and implement CRM, telephony/CCaaS, workforce management, and AI solutions with appropriate human oversight, testing, and controls.
* Develop business cases and multi-year roadmaps for staffing, outsourcing, technology, and AI investments, with clear ROI and success measures.
* Drive continuous improvement and root-cause analysis to improve first-contact resolution and reduce avoidable contact volume.
* Collaborate with Sales, Underwriting, Claims, Product, and Technology to ensure operational readiness for new products, initiatives, and system changes.
* Ensure Care Center operations and outsourced partners meet licensing, regulatory, security, privacy, and audit requirements, partnering with Legal, Compliance, and Internal audit.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Operations Management, or related field required; MBA preferred.
* 10+ years leading large, multi-channel contact center organizations, including senior leadership roles with budget ownership and a proven track record of scaling an operation through significant growth.
* Insurance industry experience, ideally in property and casualty.
* Demonstrated experience designing organizational structures and hiring, developing, and when necessary, exiting leaders at multiple levels.
* Hands-on experience evaluating, contracting, and managing outsourced/BPO partners, including vendor governance and SLA management.
* Experience selecting and implementing contact center automation and AI solutions (e.g., conversational AI, agent assist, speech analytics) with measurable implementations

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong strategic and operational leadership capabilities.
* Working knowledge of policy servicing, billing, renewals, claims, and the regulatory standards that govern them.
* Deep expertise in workforce management, forecasting, capacity planning, and service level management.
* Proficiency in continuous improvement methods such as Lean or Six Sigma.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to build scalable processes and drive operational improvement.
* Executive presence, with experience presenting business cases, performance, risk, and investment recommendations to executive leadership.
* Problem solving mindset.

**Our interview process:**

Our hiring process generally consists of 4 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well!

* **Phase 1**: Qualified candidates will first meet with a member of our People Operations team for a phone interview. This discussion is a high-level conversation to understand more about your background and interests and for us to share more about Coterie and the position.
* **Phase 2**: Selected candidates will be invited to meet with our Hiring Manager for a 2nd interview via Teams video. This interview is designed to be more detail oriented and allows you to learn more about the role and expected to be 30 minutes in length.
* **Phase 3**: Top candidates will be invited to participate in an experiential interview exercise, which includes a project provided in advance. During the interview, candidates will have a 1-hour session with the hiring manager to present and discuss their project, followed by additional 1:1 interviews with team members. The full interview series is expected to take approximately 2-3 hours.
* **Phase 4:** Final candidates will receive an invite to our final interview that will include a 1:1 interview with a member of our senior leadership team. The final interview is roughly 30 minutes.

**What's in it for you:**

Coterie has excellent benefits for all full-time employees. We offer the following:

* 100% remote
* Health insurance through Aetna (we pay 100% of premiums)
* Dental and vision insurance through Guardian (we pay 100% of premiums)
* Basic life insurance (we pay 100% of premiums)
* Access to flexible spending account (FSA) or health savings account (HSA) (for those using HSA eligible plans)
* 401K plan (up 4% match with immediate vest). Must be 21 years of age or older to participate
* Flexible PTO is expected to align with business needs and generally does not exceed approximately 5 weeks per calendar year.
* 12 company-paid holidays each year
* Continuing education annual stipend
* Annual base salary is estimated between $170,000-$200,000 based on national data. This position is also eligible for an annual Short-Term Incentive (STI) bonus based on company performance. Candidates who meet all the minimum requirements and possess additional relevant experience, as outlined in the job description, may be considered for a salary above the midpoint of the above range. Salary is based on internal equity; internal salary ranges; market data/ranges; applicant’s skills; prior relevant experience; degrees or certifications, etc.

**Work Authorization:**  
At this time, Coterie Insurance is unable to consider candidates who require current or future visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future. Falsification of an application, including work authorization status, is immediate grounds for dismissal from consideration.
