ec1221ad7c803a881ddc.title: Manager, General Liability Claims - Hybrid/Remote
ec1221ad7c803a881ddc.description:
About Us:

*At Selective, we don't just insure uniquely, we employ uniqueness.*  
  
Selective is a midsized U.S. domestic property and casualty insurance company with a history of strong, consistent financial performance for nearly 100 years. Selective's unique position as both a leading insurance group and an employer of choice is recognized in a wide variety of awards and honors, including listing in Forbes Best Midsize Employers in 2025 and certification as a Great Place to Work® in 2025 for the sixth consecutive year.  
  
Employees are empowered and encouraged to Be Uniquely You by being their true, unique selves and contributing their diverse talents, experiences, and perspectives to our shared success. Together, we are a high-performing team working to serve our customers responsibly by helping to mitigate loss, keep them safe, and restore their lives and businesses after an insured loss occurs.

Overview:

Selective Insurance is seeking a Manager, General Liability Claims to work hybrid within our footprint, possible remote for the right candidate. The General Liability Claims Manager provides strategic, technical, and operational leadership for the General Liability claims organization. The position leads claims supervisors and is accountable for claim quality, talent, workload, service, operational performance, and results across the teams reporting through them.

The Claim Manager establishes operating priorities and claim-handling expectations; oversees coverage, liability, damages, reserving, authority, negotiation, and resolution practices; and ensures material claim, compliance, financial, and customer risks are identified and escalated appropriately. The position uses claim data and performance trends to strengthen execution, improve outcomes, develop leaders, and support continuous improvement.

This role partners closely with Claims leadership, Underwriting, Actuarial, Compliance, SIU, Risk Control, Operations, Technology, and other business partners. The Claim Manager also represents Claims in interactions with insureds, agents, brokers, vendors, and other external stakeholders when leadership involvement is appropriate. All job duties and responsibilities must be carried out in compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities:

* Lead, coach, and develop General Liability claims supervisors, establishing clear expectations for leadership, accountability, talent development, employee performance, and operational results across their teams.
* Provide oversight of General Liability claim handling to promote consistent, timely, and high-quality investigation, coverage analysis, liability and damages evaluation, documentation, reserving, negotiation, and resolution.
* Provide direction on significant or complex claim matters and ensure material claim, financial, regulatory, customer, and reputational risks are identified and appropriately escalated.
* Maintain strong reserve and authority governance, including oversight of reserve adequacy, significant reserve changes, settlement recommendations, authority requests, and escalation of matters exceeding delegated authority.
* Drive operational performance across multiple teams by monitoring inventory, aging, cycle time, productivity, closing performance, service levels, claim outcomes, and adherence to established claim-handling standards.
* Optimize staffing, workload distribution, and resource allocation based on claim volume, complexity, employee capability, and changing business needs.
* Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, company policies, delegated authority, documentation requirements, and established claim practices.
* Oversee claim quality through claim reviews, audits, file reviews, calibration activities, and corrective-action plans, using findings to identify coaching, training, process, or system improvement opportunities.
* Use claims data, operational reporting, and trend analysis to evaluate performance, identify emerging issues, strengthen claim practices, and establish measurable improvement plans.
* Build organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, hiring, retention, performance management, and development of future claims leaders.
* Partner effectively with Claims leadership, Underwriting, Actuarial, Compliance, SIU, Risk Control, Operations, Technology, insureds, agents, brokers, and other stakeholders to address claim trends, service needs, and business priorities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen processes, technology, workflows, consistency, customer experience, and overall claim outcomes.

Qualifications:

KNOWLEDGE & REQUIREMENTS

* Demonstrated ability to lead and manage performance through other leaders, coach and develop supervisors, and hold leaders accountable for the performance and development of their teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability and deliver operational results.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change and continuous improvement while maintaining appropriate operational discipline and controls.
* Demonstrated expertise in commercial General Liability coverage, liability and damages evaluation, bodily injury and property damage exposures, reserving, negotiation, and claim resolution.
* Strong understanding of claim quality, reserve adequacy, settlement authority, operational performance, and effective claim-handling practices.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret claims data, operational metrics, and trends to identify issues, evaluate performance, establish priorities, and drive business decisions.
* Working knowledge of multi-jurisdictional claim-handling requirements and regulatory obligations.
* Experience using claims systems, reporting tools, analytics, and operational data to evaluate performance and guide decisions.
* Strong leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, and change-management skills.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, influencing, and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to build effective partnerships across Claims and with Underwriting, Actuarial, Compliance, Operations, Technology, and other business functions.
* Proficiency with claims systems, reporting tools, and standard Microsoft 365 applications.
* Appropriate adjuster licenses, or the ability to obtain and maintain licenses, where required.
* Ability to travel as business needs require and maintain a valid driver's license where applicable.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  

* Bachelor's degree preferred or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible Property & Casualty claims experience, including significant General Liability experience.
* 5+ years of claims leadership experience, including experience leading claims supervisors or team leaders.

Total Rewards:

Selective Insurance offers a total rewards package that includes a competitive base salary, incentive plan eligibility at all levels, and a wide array of benefits designed to help you and your family stay healthy, achieve your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. These benefits include comprehensive health care plans, retirement savings plan with company match, discounted Employee Stock Purchase Program, tuition assistance and reimbursement programs, and 20 days of paid time off. Additional details about our total rewards package can be found by visiting our benefits page.

The actual base salary is based on geographic location, and the range is representative of salaries for this role throughout Selective's footprint. Additional considerations include relevant education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and business needs.

Pay Range: USD $155,000.00 - USD $201,000.00 /Yr. Additional Information:

*Selective is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. That means we respect and value every individual’s unique opinions, beliefs, abilities, and perspectives. We are committed to promoting a welcoming culture that celebrates diverse talent, individual identity, different points of view and experiences – and empowers employees to contribute new ideas that support our continued and growing success. Building a highly engaged team is one of our core strategic imperatives, which we believe is enhanced by diversity, equity, and inclusion. We expect and encourage all employees and all of our business partners to embrace, practice, and monitor the attitudes, values, and goals of acceptance; address biases; and foster diversity of viewpoints and opinions.*

*For Massachusetts Applicants*

*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.*

5c80c6e6b0ff0adb0066.title: Senior Manager, Office of the CEO Location: Philadelphia, PA [Full time]
5c80c6e6b0ff0adb0066.description:
**Transforming Lives.** 
**Redefining Possibilities.**
------------------------------------------------------

At Jazz Pharmaceuticals plc (NASDAQ: JAZZ), our purpose is to innovate to transform the lives of patients and their families. We are dedicated to developing life-changing medicines for people with rare diseases — often with limited or no therapeutic options — so they can live their lives more fully. By transforming biopharmaceutical discoveries into novel medicines, we are working to give people around the world the opportunity to redefine what’s possible – to make the “small wins” big again.

We have a diverse portfolio of marketed medicines including leading therapies addressing rare epilepsies, cancers and sleep disorders. Our patient-focused and science-driven approach powers pioneering research and development advancements across our robust pipeline of innovative therapeutics.

* **Job Type:** Full Time
* **Travel:** Minimal (if any)
* **Level:** Senior Manager

**Our Values in Action**
------------------------

At Jazz, success is about more than skills and experience. Explore the values that guide how we work, collaborate, and make an impact for patients, our communities, and one another every day.

* Integrity
* Pursuit of Excellence
* Passion
* Collaboration
* Innovation

**One Focus. Three Key Tenets**
-------------------------------

* Jazz Pharmaceuticals has a strong, patient-focused culture that our employees believe in and are guided by every day. It is clearly identified through our purpose, vision, and core values.
* **Putting Patients First**
    
  Our purpose is innovation that transforms the lives of patients and their families. We are dedicated to developing life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases.
* **Being a Great Place to Work**
    
  Our unique culture sets us apart, and our people create a collaborative and inclusive environment that empowers everyone to grow, thrive, and succeed together.
* **Living Our Values**
    
  Our core values shape our purpose and provide a foundation for success, and we strive to put those values into action in everything we do.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID:** R040204 **Date posted:** 10/22/2026

**Senior Manager, Office of the CEO**

The Senior Manager, Office of the CEO serves as the CEO’s senior executive support partner, with primary responsibility for maximizing the CEO’s time, readiness, responsiveness, and effectiveness. As an integral member of the Office of the CEO, this role also provides administrative and operational support to the Chief of Staff and contributes to the effective execution of broader Office of the CEO priorities, including Executive Committee and Board activities. Exercising exceptional judgment and discretion, the Senior Manager oversees complex calendars, travel, meeting preparation, commitments, and day-to-day information flow while partnering across the Office to anticipate needs, coordinate priorities, and ensure seamless execution. This is primarily a remote position; however, regular travel and residence within commuting distance of a Jazz U.S. office are required to support in-person business needs. This reports to the CEO.

**Essential Functions**

* **Strategic Calendaring:** Manage the CEO’s schedule efficiently and strategically, ing critical thinking to protect time for shifting priorities and meeting preparation, including external board obligations. Schedule Executive Committee meetings (weekly, monthly, and quarterly), Board meetings, and Board committee meetings.
* **CEO Meeting Readiness:** Anticipate and coordinate all aspects of meeting preparation, including clarifying objectives, protecting meeting preparation time, confirming logistics, and partnering with the Chief of Staff to secure pre-reads and briefing materials, ensuring the CEO is fully prepared for every meeting and engagement.
* **Executive Communications and Follow-Through:** Triage requests and correspondence directed to the CEO, identify matters requiring immediate attention, coordinate timely responses with appropriate partners, and record the CEO’s commitments and follow-up actions in the team’s tracking system (Microsoft To Do).
* **Coordination:** Coordinate with designated contacts to ensure relevant business travel and commitments are reflected across the CEO’s calendars and, on occasion, assist with scheduling adjustments necessitated by changing business priorities.
* **Global Travel Planning:** Prepare detailed itineraries and coordinate all aspects of domestic and international travel, including airfare, hotels, car services, and office or desk space at Jazz locations for the CEO and Chief of Staff. Support the Chief of Staff in identifying and coordinating meaningful in-person connections between the CEO and employees while traveling.
* **Board Meeting and Director Support:** Partner with the Director of Operations and third-party providers to support Board director travel, lodging, dinner reservations, and expense reimbursement. Coordinate meeting availability and communications with directors and their executive assistants and provide scheduling and travel support as needed.
* **Board Content:** Support the upload and organization of Board meeting materials, including managing document permissions and uploading and linking approved materials, as appropriate.
* **Expense Management:** Prepare and submit expense reports for the CEO and Chief of Staff within the 30-day period required by policy. Follow up with the CEO’s direct reports regarding aging, unsubmitted transactions.
* **Procurement Management:** Manage the end-to-end process for relevant purchase requisitions, purchase orders, statements of work, check requests, and invoice submission and approval for the Office of the CEO.
* **Organizational Maintenance:** Maintain organizational charts, email distribution lists, and other team resources for the Office of the CEO.
* **Collaboration:** Partner closely with the Chief of Staff and Director of Operations, as well as administrative and Global Workplace professionals across sites and time zones, to provide consistent global support for Executive Committee meetings and other Office of the CEO priorities.
* **Team Management:** Maintain and actively use team organization and workflow tools, including OneNote and Microsoft To Do.
* **Travel Expectations:** Travel to up to six meetings per year, potentially including international travel, to support the CEO and the broader Office of the CEO.
* **Team Support:** Provide backup support to other members of the Office of the CEO, as needed.

**Qualities for Success:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of commitments and outcomes, follows through reliably, and promptly addresses or escalates issues.
* **Attention to Detail:** Maintains exceptional accuracy and organization, ensuring that details, materials, and logistics are complete and reliable.
* **Critical Thinking:** Evaluates requests, circumstances, and trade-offs thoughtfully; makes sound decisions independently and recognizes when guidance or escalation is needed.
* **Responsiveness:** Operates with urgency in a fast-paced CEO office environment and responds quickly and thoughtfully to prioritize, act on, or escalate time-sensitive matters.
* **Creativity:** Develops practical, creative approaches to challenges and improves how work is planned and executed, whether working independently or collaboratively.
* **Proactivity and Autonomy:** Anticipates needs, stays several steps ahead, and uses available networks and resources to act independently. Identifies more efficient and effective ways for the CEO and Office of the CEO to operate.
* **Enterprise Mindset and Business Acumen:** Demonstrates curiosity about the business, asks thoughtful questions to build context, and understands how priorities, decisions, and relationships connect across the organization. Applies that understanding to anticipate needs, engage the right stakeholders, and support the CEO effectively.
* **Company Stewardship:** Treats every individual with kindness, respect, and professionalism, regardless of role or level. Represents the Office of the CEO with humility and consistent alignment to Jazz values, using the access and influence associated with the role responsibly.
* **Discretion:** Maintains confidentiality and exercises discretion in all interactions, communications, and decisions.
* **Growth Mindset:** Seeks feedback, embraces new approaches, and continuously learns and develops to increase effectiveness in the role.
* **Confidence to Constructively Challenge:** Raises concerns and constructively challenges peers and senior leaders when needed to protect the CEO’s time and improve the effectiveness of the office.
* **Prioritization:** Distinguishes the most important and time-sensitive matters, manages competing demands, and continually seeks to protect and create time for the CEO’s highest-value priorities.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in a C-suite or senior-level administrative role supporting one or more senior executives.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment; experience in a biotechnology or pharmaceutical company is preferred.
* Experience working in an international organization.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, work effectively with little or no direction, and build collaborative relationships with leaders, partners, and peers.
* Self-starter who is resourceful, leverages networks, proactively seeks information, and solves problems effectively.
* Ability to work, collaborate, and communicate effectively in remote and hybrid environments.
* Ability to provide flexible support across global time zones and, when business needs require, outside standard working hours.
* Effective written and oral communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills, with the ability to interact with Board members and executives with ease.
* Strong self-awareness and commitment to ongoing development to increase autonomy and proactivity in the role.
* Ability to work in a highly energetic, flexible, and fast-paced environment.
* Project management skills or certification preferred.

**Preferred Education and Licenses**

* College degree strongly preferred.
* Proven proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, OneNote, PowerPoint, and Zoom
* Living within commuting distance of a Jazz U.S. office: Philadelphia, PA; Carlsbad, CA; or Palo Alto, CA is required and being able to work onsite as business needs require.

**Total Rewards**
-----------------

* ### **Caring for your mind.**

  We offer a market-leading Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to give employees and their families expert guidance and specialist support on any issue, including 25 counseling sessions per year to support their mental and emotional wellbeing.
    
    
  We also offer access to a variety of online classes, meditations and webinars, on-site wellbeing activities, and challenges to help our employees feel their best.
* ### **Caring for your finances.**

  To support each employee’s diverse needs, the Jazz Wellbeing Reimbursement Account is designed to provide employees with the flexibility to decide the products and services that best support their wellbeing, empowering them to choose what is most important to them.
* ### **Caring for your Work and Life.**

  Thriving at work means successfully managing and enjoying your life outside of it. At Jazz, we make space for you to recharge with generous paid time off, including Global Paid Child Bonding Leave for all new parents and Global Paid Caregiver Leave to support loved ones.

  + Global Paid Child Bonding Leave, which is available to all new parents irrespective of gender or how they are welcoming their child to their family.
  + Global Paid Caregiver Leave is available to care for a family member with a serious health condition.
* ### **Caring for your body.**

  To support physical health, we provide tools designed to keep you active and healthy wherever you are including free access to hundreds virtual classes, as well as specialized resources to support employees through every stage of life.
* ### **Flexibility and Balance.**

  At Jazz, we are proud to offer an innovative and flexible work model developed directly from employee feedback - that best serves our people and our business. Internally known as “Jazz Remix,” our norms enable teams to decide when and where they work best, adhering to principles that balance the needs of patients and personal productivity, flexibility, and wellbeing. Regularly scheduled site connection days and in-person team gatherings allow our people to maintain a genuine sense of community and connection with each other. The Jazz Remix model does not to all roles; to learn more speak with a Recruiter.
